+        self.apply_button.set_sensitive(len(self.groups) > 0)
+        self.apply_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_apply)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.apply_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.add_button(str(_("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+
+        content = self.get_content_area()
+        content.set_border_width(12)
+        content.set_spacing(6)
+
+        info = Gtk.Label(
+            label=str(
+                _(
+                    "Review duplicate references where a single media file is shared by multiple records, "
+                    "or image tags with no data references in the database. "
+                    "You can merge duplicate media records into a single keeper, create separate file copies, "
+                    "or delete unreferenced records."
+                )
+            )
+        )
+        info.set_line_wrap(True)
+        info.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        content.add(info)
+
+        if not self.groups:
+            done = Gtk.Label(
+                label=str(_("No duplicate or unreferenced media records found."))
+            )
+            done.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            content.add(done)
+            return
+
+        dup_count = sum(1 for g in self.groups if g.get("type") == "duplicate")
+        unref_count = sum(1 for g in self.groups if g.get("type") == "unreferenced")
+        count_label = Gtk.Label(
+            label=str(
+                _(
+                    "Total items to fix: %d (%d duplicate file groups, %d unreferenced image tags)"
+                )
+                % (len(self.groups), dup_count, unref_count)
+            )
+        )
+        count_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        content.add(count_label)
+
+        header_grid = create_table_grid(col_spacing=6, row_spacing=0)
+        header_grid.set_vexpand(False)
+
+        file_head = HeaderLabel(str(_("File / Media Records")))
+        ref_head = HeaderLabel(str(_("References")))
+        action_head = HeaderLabel(str(_("Resolution")))
+        action_head.set_hexpand(True)
+        hint_head = HeaderLabel(str(_("Hint")))
+        hint_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        header_grid.attach(file_head, 0, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(ref_head, 1, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(action_head, 2, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(hint_head, 3, 0, 1, 1)
+        content.add(header_grid)
+
+        self.column_sizegroups = [
+            Gtk.SizeGroup(mode=Gtk.SizeGroupMode.HORIZONTAL) for _ in range(4)
+        ]
+        self.column_sizegroups[0].add_widget(file_head)
+        self.column_sizegroups[1].add_widget(ref_head)
+        self.column_sizegroups[2].add_widget(action_head)
+        self.column_sizegroups[3].add_widget(hint_head)
+
+        content.pack_start(self.build_rows(self.groups), True, True, 0)
+
+    def build_rows(self, groups: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Gtk.ScrolledWindow:
+        grid = create_table_grid()
+        row_index = 0
+
+        for group in groups:
+            records = group["records"]
+            keeper = group["keeper"]
+            g_type = group.get("type", "duplicate")
+
+            if g_type == "unreferenced":
+                # Column 0: File path and records summary
+                desc_lines = [
+                    group["raw_path"],
+                    f"  • [{keeper['gramps_id']}] {keeper['desc'] or _('(unnamed)')} ("
+                    + str(_("Unreferenced"))
+                    + ")",
+                ]
+                file_label = TableLabel(
+                    "\n".join(desc_lines), width_chars=40, width_request=320
+                )
+                grid.attach(file_label, 0, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+                # Column 1: References summary
+                ref_label = TableLabel(
+                    f"[{keeper['gramps_id']}]: "
+                    + str(_("0 data references (unreferenced image tag)")),
+                    width_chars=40,
+                    width_request=300,
+                )
+                grid.attach(ref_label, 1, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+                # Column 2: Action ComboBox
+                action_combo = Gtk.ComboBoxText()
+                action_combo.append_text(str(_("Delete unreferenced record")))
+                action_combo.append_text(str(_("Keep unreferenced (no change)")))
+                action_combo.set_active(1)  # never delete by default
+                action_combo.set_hexpand(True)
+                grid.attach(action_combo, 2, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+                # Column 3: Hint label
+                hint_str = str(
+                    _("Unreferenced image tag: safe to remove from database")
+                )
+                if group.get("perm_issue") and group.get("inaccess_dir"):
+                    hint_str = (
+                        str(_("Permission denied at '%s'")) % group["inaccess_dir"]
+                    )
+                hint_label = TableLabel(
+                    hint_str,
+                    width_chars=36,
+                    width_request=280,
+                )
+                hint_label.set_hexpand(True)
+                grid.attach(hint_label, 3, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            else:
+                # Column 0: File path and records summary
+                desc_lines = [group["raw_path"]]
+                if group.get("perm_issue") and group.get("inaccess_dir"):
+                    desc_lines.append(
+                        f"  ⚠ "
+                        + str(_("Permission denied at: %s")) % group["inaccess_dir"]
+                    )
+                for r in records:
+                    d = r["desc"] or _("(unnamed)")
+                    desc_lines.append(f"  • [{r['gramps_id']}] {d}")
+                file_label = TableLabel(
+                    "\n".join(desc_lines), width_chars=40, width_request=320
+                )
+                grid.attach(file_label, 0, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+                # Column 1: References summary
+                ref_parts = []
+                for r in records:
+                    assoc = r.get("assoc") or r.get("desc") or _("(unnamed)")
+                    ref_parts.append(f"[{r['gramps_id']}]: {assoc}")
+                ref_label = TableLabel(
+                    "\n".join(ref_parts), width_chars=40, width_request=300
+                )
+                grid.attach(ref_label, 1, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+                # Column 2: Action ComboBox
+                action_combo = Gtk.ComboBoxText()
+                action_combo.append_text(
+                    str(_("Merge into keeper [%s]")) % keeper["gramps_id"]
+                )
+                action_combo.append_text(str(_("Create separate file copies")))
+                action_combo.append_text(str(_("Keep shared (no change)")))
+                action_combo.set_active(0)
+                action_combo.set_hexpand(True)
+                grid.attach(action_combo, 2, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+                # Column 3: Hint label
+                hint_str = str(_("Merge duplicate records into keeper [%(gid)s]")) % {
+                    "gid": keeper["gramps_id"],
+                }
+                hint_label = TableLabel(hint_str, width_chars=36, width_request=280)
+                hint_label.set_hexpand(True)
+                grid.attach(hint_label, 3, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            if row_index == 0 and hasattr(self, "column_sizegroups"):
+                self.column_sizegroups[0].add_widget(file_label)
+                self.column_sizegroups[1].add_widget(ref_label)
+                self.column_sizegroups[2].add_widget(action_combo)
+                self.column_sizegroups[3].add_widget(hint_label)
+
+            self.row_targets.append(
+                {
+                    "group": group,
+                    "action_combo": action_combo,
+                    "hint_label": hint_label,
+                    "suggested_action": 0,
+                }
+            )
+            row_index += 1
+
+        scrolled = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
+        scrolled.set_min_content_height(280)
+        scrolled.set_min_content_width(1280)
+        scrolled.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC, Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)
+        scrolled.set_hexpand(True)
+        scrolled.set_vexpand(True)
+        scrolled.add(grid)
+        return scrolled
+
+    def cb_accept_hints(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        count = 0
+        for target in self.row_targets:
+            combo = target["action_combo"]
+            if hasattr(combo, "set_active"):
+                combo.set_active(target["suggested_action"])
+                count += 1
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Hints accepted")),
+            str(
+                _(
+                    "Populated merge suggestions for %d shared media files. Review and press Apply."
+                )
+                % count
+            ),
+            parent=self,
+        )
+
+    def cb_apply(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        merged_count = 0
+        copied_count = 0
+        deleted_count = 0
+        errors: list[str] = []
+
+        for target in self.row_targets:
+            combo = target["action_combo"]
+            choice = 0
+            if hasattr(combo, "get_active"):
+                raw_choice = combo.get_active()
+                try:
+                    choice = int(raw_choice)
+                except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                    choice = 0
+            group = target["group"]
+            g_type = group.get("type", "duplicate")
+
+            if g_type == "unreferenced":
+                if choice == 0:
+                    h = group["keeper"]["handle"]
+                    try:
+                        with DbTxn(
+                            _("Remove Unreferenced Media"), self.dbstate.db
+                        ) as trans:
+                            self.dbstate.db.remove_media(h, trans)
+                            deleted_count += 1
+                    except Exception as err:
+                        LOG.exception("Failed to remove unreferenced media: %s", err)
+                        errors.append(str(err))
+                continue
+
+            if choice == 2:  # Keep shared (no change)
+                continue
+
+            records = group["records"]
+            keeper = group["keeper"]
+
+            if choice == 0:
+                # Merge duplicate records into keeper
+                keeper_media = self.dbstate.db.get_media_from_handle(keeper["handle"])
+                if not keeper_media:
+                    continue
+                for other in records:
+                    if other["handle"] == keeper["handle"]:
+                        continue
+                    try:
+                        other_media = self.dbstate.db.get_media_from_handle(
+                            other["handle"]
+                        )
+                        if other_media:
+                            query = MergeMediaQuery(
+                                self.dbstate, keeper_media, other_media
+                            )
+                            query.execute()
+                            merged_count += 1
+                    except Exception as err:
+                        LOG.exception("Failed to merge media record: %s", err)
+                        errors.append(str(err))
+
+            elif choice == 1:
+                # Create separate file copies for each duplicate record
+                src_path = clean_path(group["raw_path"])
+                try:
+                    src_full = clean_path(media_path_full(self.dbstate.db, src_path))
+                except Exception:
+                    src_full = src_path
+
+                base, ext = os.path.splitext(src_path)
+                claimed: set[str] = set()
+                with DbTxn(_("Split Media References"), self.dbstate.db) as trans:
+                    for r in records[1:]:
+                        new_rel = f"{base}_{r['gramps_id']}{ext}"
+                        try:
+                            expected = media_path_full(self.dbstate.db, new_rel)
+                        except Exception:
+                            expected = new_rel
+                        if not os.path.exists(src_full):
+                            errors.append(
+                                "[%s] source file not found: %s"
+                                % (r["gramps_id"], src_full)
+                            )
+                            continue
+                        dest_full = unique_destination(expected, claimed, src_full)
+                        if dest_full != expected:  # keep DB path and disk name in step
+                            extra = os.path.splitext(dest_full)[0][
+                                len(os.path.splitext(expected)[0]) :
+                            ]
+                            new_rel = f"{base}_{r['gramps_id']}{extra}{ext}"
+                        ok, copy_err = relocate_file(src_full, dest_full, copy=True)
+                        if not ok:
+                            LOG.warning("Failed to copy media file: %s", copy_err)
+                            errors.append("[%s] %s" % (r["gramps_id"], copy_err))
+                            continue
+                        copied_count += 1
+                        other_media = self.dbstate.db.get_media_from_handle(r["handle"])
+                        if other_media:
+                            other_media.set_path(new_rel)
+                            self.dbstate.db.commit_media(other_media, trans)
+
+        if merged_count == 0 and copied_count == 0 and deleted_count == 0:
+            OkDialog(
+                str(_("Nothing to apply")),
+                str(
+                    _(
+                        "No actions selected. Choose 'Merge', 'Create copies', or 'Delete' for one or more records first."
+                    )
+                ),
+                parent=self,
+            )
+            return
+
+        summary = []
+        if merged_count > 0:
+            summary.append(str(_("Merged %d duplicate media records.")) % merged_count)
+        if copied_count > 0:
+            summary.append(str(_("Created %d separate media files.")) % copied_count)
+        if deleted_count > 0:
+            summary.append(
+                str(_("Deleted %d unreferenced media records.")) % deleted_count
+            )
+
+        msg = " ".join(summary)
+        if errors:
+            msg += "\n\n" + "\n".join(errors)
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Media References Resolved")),
+            msg + "\n\n" + str(_("Close and reopen this dialog to rescan.")),
+            parent=self,
+        )
+
+        # Update button sensitivities and group records after applying
+        self.groups = []
+        self.row_targets = []
+        if hasattr(self, "apply_button"):
+            self.apply_button.set_sensitive(False)
+        if hasattr(self, "accept_button"):
+            self.accept_button.set_sensitive(False)
+
+    def show_dialog(self) -> None:
+        self.show_all()
+        while True:
+            resp = self.run()
+            if resp in (
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CANCEL,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.DELETE_EVENT,
+            ):
+                break
+        self.destroy()
+
+
+# Backward compatibility alias
+ApplyFilenameStandardsDialog = FixMediaReferencesDialog

+                ),
+            },
+        ],
+        key=lambda entry: entry["name"].lower(),
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_all(cls) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+        """Return all gold-standard repository definitions."""
+        return [dict(entry) for entry in cls.GENEALOGY_REPOSITORIES]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_names(cls) -> list[str]:
+        """Return the names of all gold-standard repositories."""
+        return [entry["name"] for entry in cls.GENEALOGY_REPOSITORIES]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_by_name(cls, name: str) -> dict[str, str] | None:
+        """Return the gold-standard entry matching a name, or None."""
+        for entry in cls.GENEALOGY_REPOSITORIES:
+            if entry["name"] == name:
+                return dict(entry)
+        return None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_display_label(cls, name: str) -> str:
+        """Return the dropdown label showing description and URL."""
+        entry = cls.get_by_name(name)
+        if entry is None:
+            return name
+        description = entry["notes"]
+        # Keep only the first sentence so the dropdown stays compact.
+        if "." in description:
+            description = description.split(".", 1)[0] + "."
+        return f"{entry['name']} -- {description} [{entry['url']}]"
+
+    @classmethod
+    def as_dict(cls) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
+        """Return the catalog keyed by repository name."""
+        return {entry["name"]: dict(entry) for entry in cls.GENEALOGY_REPOSITORIES}

+"""Dialog to review and fix note issues (import debris, empty notes, whitespace)."""

+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# Standard Python modules
+#
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+from __future__ import annotations

+    is_bare_url_text,
+    is_debris_text,

+_ = glocale.translation.sgettext
+LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)

+def _url_already_in_every_citation_page(db: Any, note_handle: str, url: str) -> bool:
+    """True when every user of the note is a citation whose page holds ``url``."""
+    users = list(db.find_backlink_handles(note_handle))
+    if not users:
+        return False
+    for class_name, handle in users:
+        if class_name != "Citation":
+            return False
+        citation = db.get_citation_from_handle(handle)
+        if citation is None or url not in str(citation.get_page() or ""):
+            return False
+    return True
+
+
+def build_note_fix_rows(db: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Scan for notes with hygiene problems (debris, empty, whitespace, repeated URL)."""
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for note in db.iter_notes():
+        n_handle = str(note.get_handle() or "")
+        n_gid = str(note.get_gramps_id() or "")
+        raw_text = note_text(note)
+        n_type = str(note.get_type()) if hasattr(note, "get_type") else "Note"
+
+        suggested_action = ""
+        suggested_text = ""
+        hint_text = ""
+        problem = None
+
+        stripped = raw_text.strip()
+        if not stripped:
+            # Empty note
+            suggested_action = _("Purge")
+            suggested_text = _("[Purge note]")
+            hint_text = _("Empty note (suggest Purge)")
+            problem = "empty"
+        elif is_debris_text(stripped):
+            # Automated migration/export debris note
+            suggested_action = _("Purge")
+            suggested_text = _("[Purge note]")
+            hint_text = _("Import debris / migration log (suggest Purge)")
+            problem = "debris"
+        elif is_bare_url_text(stripped) and _url_already_in_every_citation_page(
+            db, n_handle, stripped
+        ):
+            # The same web address is already in the Volume/Page field of
+            # every citation that uses this note, so the note repeats it.
+            suggested_action = _("Purge")
+            suggested_text = _("[Purge note]")
+            hint_text = _("Web address already in the citation page (suggest Purge)")
+            problem = "duplicate_url"
+        elif raw_text != stripped:
+            # Leading or trailing whitespace
+            suggested_action = _("Trim")
+            suggested_text = stripped
+            hint_text = _("Leading/trailing whitespace (suggest Trim)")
+            problem = "whitespace"
+
+        if not problem:
+            continue
+
+        display_lines = [
+            f"{n_gid} ({n_type})",
+            (
+                stripped[:160] + ("..." if len(stripped) > 160 else "")
+                if stripped
+                else _("(empty)")
+            ),
+        ]
+
+        rows.append(
+            {
+                "note_handle": n_handle,
+                "gramps_id": n_gid,
+                "note_type": n_type,
+                "raw_text": raw_text,
+                "display_text": "\n".join(display_lines),
+                "suggested_action": suggested_action,
+                "suggested_text": suggested_text,
+                "hint_text": hint_text,
+                "problem": problem,
+            }
+        )
+
+    # Sort by problem type, then Gramps ID
+    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["problem"] != "debris", r["gramps_id"]))
+    return rows
+

+# ------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# NotesFixDialog

+# ------------------------------------------------------------
+class NotesFixDialog(Gtk.Dialog):
+    """Review and fix notes with From (labels) / To (textboxes) columns, hints, Accept and Apply."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        title: str | None = None,
+        dbstate: Any = None,
+        description: str | None = None,
+        transient_for: Gtk.Window | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        dialog_title = title or str(_("Fix Notes"))
+        super().__init__(
+            title=dialog_title,
+            transient_for=transient_for,
+            modal=True,
+            destroy_with_parent=True,
+        )
+        self.dbstate = dbstate
+        self.rows = build_note_fix_rows(dbstate.db)
+        self.row_targets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        self.set_default_size(1400, 520)
+
+        # Action buttons in dialog action bar (always visible at bottom)
+        n_hints = len(self.rows)
+        self.accept_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Accept hints (%d)")) % n_hints)
+        self.accept_button.set_sensitive(n_hints > 0)
+        self.accept_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_accept_hints)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.accept_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.apply_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Apply")))
+        self.apply_button.set_sensitive(n_hints > 0)
+        self.apply_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_apply)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.apply_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.add_button(str(_("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+
+        content = self.get_content_area()
+        content.set_border_width(12)
+        content.set_spacing(6)
+
+        if not self.rows:
+            done = Gtk.Label(label=str(_("No note problems found.")))
+            done.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            content.add(done)
+            return
+
+        count_label = Gtk.Label(
+            label=str(_("Total problem notes found: %d") % len(self.rows))
+        )
+        count_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        content.add(count_label)
+
+        # Header row above the scrolled grid
+        header_grid = Gtk.Grid()
+        header_grid.set_column_spacing(6)
+        header_grid.set_row_spacing(0)
+        header_grid.set_hexpand(True)
+        header_grid.set_vexpand(False)
+
+        from_head = Gtk.Label()
+        from_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Note")))
+        from_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        from_head.set_hexpand(False)
+
+        action_head = Gtk.Label()
+        action_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Action")))
+        action_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        action_head.set_hexpand(False)
+
+        to_head = Gtk.Label()
+        to_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Note")))
+        to_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        to_head.set_hexpand(False)
+
+        hint_head = Gtk.Label()
+        hint_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Hint")))
+        hint_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        hint_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        header_grid.attach(from_head, 0, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(action_head, 1, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(to_head, 2, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(hint_head, 3, 0, 1, 1)
+        content.add(header_grid)
+
+        # SizeGroups ensuring header columns match data columns below
+        self.column_sizegroups = [
+            Gtk.SizeGroup(mode=Gtk.SizeGroupMode.HORIZONTAL) for _ in range(4)
+        ]
+        self.column_sizegroups[0].add_widget(from_head)
+        self.column_sizegroups[1].add_widget(action_head)
+        self.column_sizegroups[2].add_widget(to_head)
+        self.column_sizegroups[3].add_widget(hint_head)
+
+        content.pack_start(self.build_rows(self.rows), True, True, 0)
+
+        desc_text = (
+            description
+            if description is not None
+            else str(_("Remove import debris and convert bare-URL notes."))
+        )
+        hint_footer = Gtk.Label(
+            label=f"{desc_text} "
+            + str(
+                _(
+                    "Press 'Accept hints' to populate suggested changes into "
+                    "the target columns, edit any values as needed, then press 'Apply'."

+            )
+        )
+        hint_footer.set_line_wrap(True)
+        hint_footer.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        hint_footer.set_size_request(-1, 45)
+        content.pack_start(hint_footer, False, False, 0)

+    def build_rows(self, entries: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Gtk.ScrolledWindow:
+        """Build the data grid for reviewing and editing notes."""
+        grid = Gtk.Grid()
+        grid.set_column_spacing(6)
+        grid.set_row_spacing(6)
+        grid.set_hexpand(True)
+        grid.set_vexpand(True)
+
+        row_index = 0
+        for entry in entries:
+            # Column 0: From (Current Note) - Label
+            from_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=2)
+            from_box.set_size_request(320, -1)
+            lines = entry.get("display_text", "").splitlines()
+            l1 = Gtk.Label(label=lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else "")
+            l1.set_xalign(0.0)
+            l1.set_line_wrap(True)
+            l1.set_line_wrap_mode(Pango.WrapMode.WORD_CHAR)
+            l1.set_max_width_chars(42)
+            from_box.pack_start(l1, False, False, 0)
+
+            l2 = Gtk.Label(label=lines[1] if len(lines) > 1 else "")
+            l2.set_xalign(0.0)
+            l2.set_line_wrap(True)
+            l2.set_line_wrap_mode(Pango.WrapMode.WORD_CHAR)
+            l2.set_max_width_chars(42)
+            from_box.pack_start(l2, False, False, 0)
+
+            grid.attach(from_box, 0, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            # Column 1: To (Action) - Entry (empty by default)
+            action_entry = Gtk.Entry()
+            action_entry.set_width_chars(12)
+            action_entry.set_text("")
+            grid.attach(action_entry, 1, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            # Column 2: To (New Text) - Entry (empty by default)
+            text_entry = Gtk.Entry()
+            text_entry.set_width_chars(32)
+            text_entry.set_text("")
+            grid.attach(text_entry, 2, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            # Column 3: Hint - Label
+            hint_label = Gtk.Label(label=entry.get("hint_text", ""))
+            hint_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            hint_label.set_xalign(0.0)
+            hint_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+            hint_label.set_line_wrap_mode(Pango.WrapMode.WORD_CHAR)
+            hint_label.set_size_request(240, -1)
+            hint_label.set_max_width_chars(32)
+            grid.attach(hint_label, 3, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            if row_index == 0 and hasattr(self, "column_sizegroups"):
+                self.column_sizegroups[0].add_widget(from_box)
+                self.column_sizegroups[1].add_widget(action_entry)
+                self.column_sizegroups[2].add_widget(text_entry)
+                self.column_sizegroups[3].add_widget(hint_label)
+
+            self.row_targets.append(
+                {
+                    "entry": entry,
+                    "action_entry": action_entry,
+                    "text_entry": text_entry,
+                    "hint_label": hint_label,
+                }
+            )
+            row_index += 1
+
+        scrolled = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
+        scrolled.set_min_content_height(300)
+        scrolled.set_min_content_width(1200)
+        scrolled.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC, Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)
+        scrolled.set_hexpand(True)
+        scrolled.set_vexpand(True)
+        scrolled.add(grid)
+        return scrolled
+
+    def cb_accept_hints(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        """Populate suggested values into target textboxes."""
+        populated_count = 0
+        for target in self.row_targets:
+            item = target["entry"]
+            sug_action = item.get("suggested_action", "")
+            sug_text = item.get("suggested_text", "")
+
+            changed = False
+            if sug_action and not target["action_entry"].get_text():
+                target["action_entry"].set_text(sug_action)
+                changed = True
+            if sug_text and not target["text_entry"].get_text():
+                target["text_entry"].set_text(sug_text)
+                changed = True
+
+            if changed:
+                populated_count += 1
+
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Hints accepted")),
+            str(
+                _(
+                    "Populated suggested actions into target columns for %d notes. "
+                    "Review or edit them, then press Apply."
+                )
+            )
+            % populated_count,
+            parent=self,
+        )
+
+    def cb_apply(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        """Apply target column data directly into note records in the database."""
+        applied_count = 0
+        with DbTxn(_("Fix Notes"), self.dbstate.db) as trans:
+            for target in self.row_targets:
+                item = target["entry"]
+                if apply_note_fix(
+                    self.dbstate.db,
+                    trans,
+                    str(item.get("note_handle") or ""),
+                    action=target["action_entry"].get_text(),
+                    new_text=target["text_entry"].get_text(),
+                    raw_text=item.get("raw_text", ""),
+                ):
+                    applied_count += 1
+
+        if applied_count == 0:
+            OkDialog(
+                str(_("Nothing to apply")),
+                str(
+                    _(
+                        "No target values entered. Press 'Accept hints' or type "
+                        "values into the target columns first."
+                    )
+                ),
+                parent=self,
+            )
+            return
+
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Note fixes applied")),
+            str(_("Updated or removed %d notes in the database.")) % applied_count,
+            parent=self,
+        )
+
+    def show_dialog(self) -> None:
+        """Display the modal dialog until user explicitly closes it."""
+        self.show_all()
+        while True:
+            resp = self.run()
+            if resp in (
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CANCEL,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.DELETE_EVENT,
+            ):
+                break
+        self.destroy()
+
+
+def apply_note_fix(
+    db: Any,
+    trans: Any,
+    note_handle: str,
+    action: str = "",
+    new_text: str = "",
+    raw_text: str = "",
+) -> bool:
+    """Purge, trim or rewrite one note; the one implementation for all callers.
+
+    ``action`` is ``purge`` or ``trim`` (any case). A purge detaches the note
+    from every object that uses it, then deletes it. Returns True if the
+    note was changed or removed.
+    """
+    act = (action or "").strip().lower()
+    new_text = (new_text or "").strip()
+    if not act and not new_text:
+        return False
+    try:
+        note = db.get_note_from_handle(note_handle)
+    except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+        note = None
+    if note is None:
+        return False
+    if act == "purge" or new_text.lower() == "[purge note]":
+        for class_name, parent_handle in list(db.find_backlink_handles(note_handle)):
+            getter = getattr(db, "get_%s_from_handle" % class_name.lower(), None)
+            commit = getattr(db, "commit_%s" % class_name.lower(), None)
+            if getter and commit:
+                parent = getter(parent_handle)
+                if parent is not None:
+                    parent.remove_handle_references("Note", [note_handle])
+                    commit(parent, trans)
+        db.remove_note(note_handle, trans)
+        return True
+    if new_text and new_text != raw_text:
+        note.set(new_text)
+        db.commit_note(note, trans)
+        return True
+    if act == "trim":
+        note.set(str(note.get() or "").strip())
+        db.commit_note(note, trans)
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def auto_fix_notes(db: Any) -> int:
+    """Accept every hint and apply it in one transaction (one undo).
+
+    Returns the number of notes changed or removed.
+    """
+    changed = 0
+    with DbTxn(_("Fix Notes"), db) as trans:
+        for row in build_note_fix_rows(db):
+            if apply_note_fix(
+                db,
+                trans,
+                row["note_handle"],
+                # Fixed codes, not the translated button text.
+                action="trim" if row["problem"] == "whitespace" else "purge",
+                raw_text=row["raw_text"],
+            ):
+                changed += 1
+    return changed

+#
+# Standard Python modules
+#
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+from __future__ import annotations
+import difflib
+import logging
+from collections import defaultdict
+from typing import Any
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# GTK modules
+#
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+from gi.repository import Gdk, Gtk, Pango
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# Gramps modules
+#
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+from gramps.gen.const import GRAMPS_LOCALE as glocale
+from gramps.gen.db import DbTxn
+from gramps.gen.lib import Note, NoteType
+from gramps.gui.dialog import ErrorDialog, OkDialog
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gw_goldstandardrepos import GoldStandardRepositories
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardcitationrepairengine import (
+    GWizardCitationRepairEngine,
+)
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardcitationshared import normalize_repo_name
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardcitationfix import rank_golden_repo_matches
+
+_ = glocale.translation.sgettext
+LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _strip_the(text: str) -> str:
+    """Return text lower-cased with a leading 'the ' removed."""
+    low = " ".join((text or "").split()).casefold()
+    return low[4:] if low.startswith("the ") else low
+
+
+def classify_repo_street(repo_name: str, street: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Decide what to do with a repository address street line.
+
+    :returns: ``(action, detail)`` where action is ``"keep"`` (a real
+        address), ``"drop"`` (it only repeats the repository name) or
+        ``"move"`` (it is the name followed by extra text, returned as
+        *detail*, which belongs in a note rather than an address).
+    """
+    street = " ".join((street or "").split())
+    if not street:
+        return "keep", ""
+    name_key = _strip_the(repo_name)
+    street_key = _strip_the(street)
+    if not name_key:
+        return "keep", ""
+    if street_key == name_key:
+        return "drop", ""
+    if street_key.startswith(name_key):
+        base = street[4:] if street.casefold().startswith("the ") else street
+        name_base = (
+            " ".join(repo_name.split())[4:]
+            if " ".join(repo_name.split()).casefold().startswith("the ")
+            else " ".join(repo_name.split())
+        )
+        remainder = base[len(name_base) :].strip(" \t-:;,")
+        remainder = remainder.strip("()[] ").strip()
+        if remainder:
+            return "move", remainder
+        return "drop", ""
+    return "keep", ""
+
+
+def _find_or_create_golden(
+    db: Any,
+    golden_name: str,
+    engine: GWizardCitationRepairEngine | None,
+    trans: Any,
+) -> tuple[str | None, bool]:
+    """Return ``(handle, created)`` for a golden repository.
+
+    The repository is created inside ``trans`` when it does not exist, so
+    creating it and merging into it are one undo step.
+    """
+    for repo in db.iter_repositories():
+        if repo and repo.get_name() == golden_name:
+            return str(repo.get_handle()), False
+    repair_engine = engine or GWizardCitationRepairEngine()
+    try:
+        return repair_engine._create_repository(db, golden_name, trans), True
+    except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+        LOG.exception("Failed to create golden repository %s", golden_name)
+        return None, False
+
+
+def _resolve_golden_keeper(
+    db: Any, golden_name: str, engine: GWizardCitationRepairEngine | None = None
+) -> str | None:
+    """Return the handle for a golden repository, creating it if needed."""
+    with DbTxn(_("Create repository"), db) as trans:
+        handle, _created = _find_or_create_golden(db, golden_name, engine, trans)
+    return handle
+
+
+def _tidy_keeper_address(
+    db: Any, keeper_handle: str, trans: Any = None
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Clean address lines on the surviving repository.
+
+    Joins ``trans`` when given, otherwise makes its own transaction.
+
+    :returns: ``(removed, moved)`` counts.
+    """
+    if trans is None:
+        with DbTxn(_("Tidy repository address"), db) as new_trans:
+            return _tidy_keeper_address(db, keeper_handle, new_trans)
+    repo = db.get_repository_from_handle(keeper_handle)
+    if repo is None:
+        return 0, 0
+    name = repo.get_name() or ""
+    removed = moved = 0
+    kept = []
+    details: list[str] = []
+    for addr in repo.get_address_list():
+        action, detail = classify_repo_street(name, addr.get_street())
+        if action == "keep":
+            kept.append(addr)
+            continue
+        if action == "move":
+            details.append(detail)
+        addr.set_street("")
+        others = (
+            addr.get_locality(),
+            addr.get_city(),
+            addr.get_county(),
+            addr.get_state(),
+            addr.get_country(),
+            addr.get_postal_code(),
+            addr.get_phone(),
+        )
+        if any((value or "").strip() for value in others):
+            kept.append(addr)
+        else:
+            removed += 1
+    try:
+        repo.set_address_list(kept)
+        for detail in details:
+            text = str(_("Place detail from address: %s")) % detail
+            if any(
+                (db.get_note_from_handle(n_handle) is not None)
+                and db.get_note_from_handle(n_handle).get() == text
+                for n_handle in repo.get_note_list()
+            ):
+                continue
+            note = Note()
+            note.set(text)
+            note.set_type(NoteType.REPO)
+            note_handle = db.add_note(note, trans)
+            repo.add_note(note_handle)
+            moved += 1
+        db.commit_repository(repo, trans)
+    except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+        LOG.exception("Failed to tidy address for repository %s", name)
+        return 0, 0
+    return removed, moved
+
+
+def _resolve_chain(handle: str, targets: dict[str, str]) -> str:
+    """Follow merge targets to the final keeper, stopping at any cycle."""
+    seen = {handle}
+    current = handle
+    while current in targets:
+        current = targets[current]
+        if current in seen:
+            return handle
+        seen.add(current)
+    return current
+
+
+def apply_repo_consolidations(
+    db: Any,
+    changes: list[tuple[str, str]],
+    engine: GWizardCitationRepairEngine | None = None,
+    trans: Any = None,
+    tidy_handles: list[str] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Merge repositories and tidy their addresses in one transaction.
+
+    ``changes`` is a list of ``(discard_handle, target)`` where target is a
+    repository handle or ``GOLDEN:<name>`` (the golden repository is created
+    when missing). Targets that are themselves merged away are followed to
+    the final keeper. ``tidy_handles`` are repositories whose address should
+    be cleaned in place without a merge. This is the one implementation used
+    by the dialog's Apply button, its ``run_auto`` and Accept all hints.
+
+    :returns: dict with ``merged``, ``created``, ``removed``, ``moved`` counts
+        and an ``errors`` list.
+    """
+    if trans is None:
+        with DbTxn(_("Consolidate Repositories"), db) as new_trans:
+            return apply_repo_consolidations(
+                db, changes, engine, new_trans, tidy_handles
+            )
+    repair_engine = engine or GWizardCitationRepairEngine()
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "merged": 0,
+        "created": 0,
+        "removed": 0,
+        "moved": 0,
+        "errors": [],
+    }
+    golden_cache: dict[str, str] = {}
+    targets: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for discard_handle, target_val in changes:
+        if not target_val:
+            continue
+        if target_val.startswith("GOLDEN:"):
+            golden_name = target_val[7:]
+            keeper_handle = golden_cache.get(golden_name)
+            if keeper_handle is None:
+                keeper_handle, created = _find_or_create_golden(
+                    db, golden_name, repair_engine, trans
+                )
+                if keeper_handle is None:
+                    result["errors"].append(
+                        str(_("Could not create golden repository '%s'.")) % golden_name
+                    )
+                    continue
+                golden_cache[golden_name] = keeper_handle
+                if created:
+                    result["created"] += 1
+        else:
+            keeper_handle = target_val
+        if keeper_handle != discard_handle:
+            targets[discard_handle] = keeper_handle
+
+    keepers: list[str] = []
+    for discard_handle in targets:
+        keeper_handle = _resolve_chain(discard_handle, targets)
+        if keeper_handle == discard_handle:
+            continue
+        try:
+            if repair_engine.merge_repositories(
+                db, keeper_handle, discard_handle, trans
+            ):
+                result["merged"] += 1
+                if keeper_handle not in keepers:
+                    keepers.append(keeper_handle)
+            else:
+                result["errors"].append(
+                    str(_("Failed to merge %s into %s."))
+                    % (discard_handle, keeper_handle)
+                )
+        except Exception as err:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Merge failed for %s -> %s", discard_handle, keeper_handle)
+            result["errors"].append(str(err))
+
+    for handle in keepers + [h for h in (tidy_handles or []) if h not in keepers]:
+        removed, moved = _tidy_keeper_address(db, handle, trans)
+        result["removed"] += removed
+        result["moved"] += moved
+
+    try:
+        repair_engine.apply_gold_standard_details(db, trans)
+    except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+        LOG.exception("Failed to apply gold standard details")
+    return result
+
+
+def auto_consolidate_repositories(
+    db: Any, engine: GWizardCitationRepairEngine | None = None
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Accept every hint and apply it, as the Repository Consolidate dialog does.
+
+    Also cleans the address of repositories that have an address problem
+    but no merge target. Returns the dict from ``apply_repo_consolidations``.
+    """
+    rows = build_repo_consolidate_rows(db)
+    changes = [
+        (row["handle"], row["hint_target"]) for row in rows if row["hint_target"]
+    ]
+    tidy = [
+        row["handle"]
+        for row in rows
+        if not row["hint_target"] and row["problem"] == "address"
+    ]
+    return apply_repo_consolidations(db, changes, engine, tidy_handles=tidy)
+
+
+def build_repo_consolidate_rows(db: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Build per-repository consolidation rows from database."""
+    if db is None:
+        return []
+
+    repos: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    golden_names = GoldStandardRepositories.get_names()
+    golden_set = set(golden_names)
+
+    existing_golden_handles: dict[str, str] = {}
+    handle_list = (
+        list(db.iter_repository_handles())
+        if hasattr(db, "iter_repository_handles")
+        else list(db.get_repository_handles())
+    )
+
+    for handle in handle_list:
+        repo = db.get_repository_from_handle(handle)
+        if repo is None:
+            continue
+        name = str(repo.get_name() or "").strip()
+        gid = str(repo.get_gramps_id() or "")
+        sources: list[str] = []
+        if hasattr(db, "find_backlink_handles"):
+            try:
+                for item in db.find_backlink_handles(handle, ["Source"]):
+                    s_h = item[1] if isinstance(item, (tuple, list)) else item
+                    sources.append(str(s_h))
+            except Exception:
+                sources = []
+
+        source_titles: list[str] = []
+        for s_h in sources[:3]:
+            s_obj = db.get_source_from_handle(s_h)
+            if s_obj and s_obj.get_title():
+                source_titles.append(str(s_obj.get_title()).strip())
+
+        if len(sources) == 0:
+            summary = str(_("No sources"))
+        elif source_titles:
+            sample = ", ".join(source_titles[:2])
+            summary = f"{len(sources)} sources: {sample}"
+        else:
+            summary = f"{len(sources)} sources"
+
+        is_golden = name in golden_set
+        if is_golden:
+            existing_golden_handles[name] = handle
+
+        addr_issue = False
+        for addr in repo.get_address_list():
+            act, _det = classify_repo_street(name, addr.get_street())
+            if act in ("drop", "move"):
+                addr_issue = True
+                break
+
+        repos.append(
+            {
+                "handle": handle,
+                "name": name,
+                "gramps_id": gid,
+                "display": f"{name} ({gid})" if gid else (name or _("(unnamed)")),
+                "source_count": len(sources),
+                "sources_summary": summary,
+                "norm_name": normalize_repo_name(name),
+                "is_golden": is_golden,
+                "addr_issue": addr_issue,
+            }
+        )
+
+    # Group duplicate repositories by normalized name or similarity
+    groups: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for r in repos:
+        if r["norm_name"]:
+            groups[r["norm_name"]].append(r)
+
+    merged_groups: list[list[dict[str, Any]]] = []
+    handled_handles: set[str] = set()
+
+    for _norm_key, members in groups.items():
+        if len(members) >= 2:
+            merged_groups.append(members)
+            for m in members:
+                handled_handles.add(m["handle"])
+
+    remaining = [r for r in repos if r["handle"] not in handled_handles]
+    used_in_fuzzy: set[str] = set()
+    for i, r1 in enumerate(remaining):
+        if r1["handle"] in used_in_fuzzy:
+            continue
+        cluster = [r1]
+        for j in range(i + 1, len(remaining)):
+            r2 = remaining[j]
+            if r2["handle"] in used_in_fuzzy:
+                continue
+            k1 = r1["norm_name"]
+            k2 = r2["norm_name"]
+            if not k1 or not k2:
+                continue
+            if (
+                k1 in k2
+                or k2 in k1
+                or difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, k1, k2).ratio() >= 0.75
+            ):
+                cluster.append(r2)
+                used_in_fuzzy.add(r2["handle"])
+        if len(cluster) >= 2:
+            merged_groups.append(cluster)
+            used_in_fuzzy.add(r1["handle"])
+            for m in cluster:
+                handled_handles.add(m["handle"])
+
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    for group in merged_groups:
+        group.sort(
+            key=lambda r: (
+                not r["is_golden"],
+                -r["source_count"],
+                r["gramps_id"],
+            )
+        )
+        keeper = group[0]
+        keeper_disp = keeper["display"]
+
+        for member in group:
+            m_handle = member["handle"]
+            m_disp = member["display"]
+            is_keeper = m_handle == keeper["handle"]
+
+            options = [(m_disp, m_handle)]
+            for other in group:
+                if other["handle"] != m_handle:
+                    options.append((other["display"], other["handle"]))
+            for other_repo in repos:
+                if other_repo["handle"] != m_handle and other_repo not in group:
+                    options.append((other_repo["display"], other_repo["handle"]))
+            for g_name in golden_names:
+                g_val = existing_golden_handles.get(g_name, f"GOLDEN:{g_name}")
+                if g_val != m_handle and all(opt[1] != g_val for opt in options):
+                    disp_label = GoldStandardRepositories.get_display_label(g_name)
+                    options.append((disp_label, g_val))
+
+            if is_keeper:
+                hint_target = ""
+                hint_reason = ""
+                hint_display = ""
+            else:
+                hint_target = keeper["handle"]
+                if keeper["is_golden"]:
+                    hint_reason = str(_("Matches gold standard"))
+                elif keeper["source_count"] > member["source_count"]:
+                    hint_reason = (
+                        str(_("Keeper has %d sources")) % keeper["source_count"]
+                    )
+                else:
+                    hint_reason = str(_("Preferred keeper"))
+                hint_display = f"{keeper_disp}\n({hint_reason})"
+
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "handle": m_handle,
+                    "name": member["name"],
+                    "gramps_id": member["gramps_id"],
+                    "display": m_disp,
+                    "sources_summary": member["sources_summary"],
+                    "options": options,
+                    "hint_target": hint_target,
+                    "hint_reason": hint_reason,
+                    "hint_display": hint_display,
+                    "is_keeper": is_keeper,
+                    "problem": "duplicate",
+                }
+            )
+
+    for member in repos:
+        if member["handle"] in handled_handles:
+            continue
+        m_handle = member["handle"]
+        m_name = member["name"]
+        m_disp = member["display"]
+
+        hint_target = ""
+        hint_reason = ""
+        hint_display = ""
+
+        if not member["is_golden"]:
+            ranked = rank_golden_repo_matches(m_name, golden_names, limit=1)
+            best_golden = ranked[0] if ranked else None
+            if best_golden:
+                norm_m = member["norm_name"]
+                norm_g = normalize_repo_name(best_golden)
+                ratio = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm_m, norm_g).ratio()
+                if norm_m in norm_g or norm_g in norm_m or ratio >= 0.6:
+                    if best_golden in existing_golden_handles:
+                        target_h = existing_golden_handles[best_golden]
+                        if target_h != m_handle:
+                            hint_target = target_h
+                            hint_reason = str(_("Merge into existing %s")) % best_golden
+                            target_disp = next(
+                                (
+                                    r["display"]
+                                    for r in repos
+                                    if r["handle"] == target_h
+                                ),
+                                best_golden,
+                            )
+                            hint_display = f"{target_disp}\n({hint_reason})"
+                    else:
+                        hint_target = f"GOLDEN:{best_golden}"
+                        hint_reason = str(_("Gold-standard match"))
+                        hint_display = f"{best_golden}\n({hint_reason})"
+
+        if hint_target or member["addr_issue"]:
+            options = [(m_disp, m_handle)]
+            for other_repo in repos:
+                if other_repo["handle"] != m_handle:
+                    options.append((other_repo["display"], other_repo["handle"]))
+            for g_name in golden_names:
+                g_val = existing_golden_handles.get(g_name, f"GOLDEN:{g_name}")
+                if g_val != m_handle and all(opt[1] != g_val for opt in options):
+                    disp_label = GoldStandardRepositories.get_display_label(g_name)
+                    options.append((disp_label, g_val))
+
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "handle": m_handle,
+                    "name": m_name,
+                    "gramps_id": member["gramps_id"],
+                    "display": m_disp,
+                    "sources_summary": member["sources_summary"],
+                    "options": options,
+                    "hint_target": hint_target,
+                    "hint_reason": hint_reason,
+                    "hint_display": hint_display,
+                    "is_keeper": False,
+                    "problem": "golden_match" if hint_target else "address",
+                }
+            )
+
+    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (not bool(r["hint_target"]), r["name"].lower()))
+    return rows
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# RepoConsolidateDialog
+#
+# ------------------------------------------------------------
+class RepoConsolidateDialog(Gtk.Dialog):
+    """Review and consolidate repository records in a grid dialog."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dbstate: Any,
+        title: str | None = None,
+        description: str | None = None,
+        transient_for: Gtk.Window | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Build the repository consolidate dialog."""
+        dlg_title = title if title is not None else str(_("Repository Consolidate"))
+        super().__init__(
+            title=dlg_title,
+            transient_for=transient_for,
+            modal=True,
+            destroy_with_parent=True,
+        )
+        self.dbstate = dbstate
+        self.engine = GWizardCitationRepairEngine()
+        self.combos: list[tuple[str, Gtk.ComboBox, str]] = []
+        self.row_combos: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], Gtk.ComboBox]] = []
+        self.set_default_size(1480, 520)
+
+        content = self.get_content_area()
+        content.set_border_width(12)
+        content.set_spacing(6)
+
+        rows = build_repo_consolidate_rows(self.dbstate.db)
+        n_repos = len(rows)
+
+        count_label = Gtk.Label()
+        count_label.set_markup(
+            "<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Problem repositories (%d total)") % n_repos)
+        )
+        count_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        count_label.set_hexpand(True)
+        content.add(count_label)
+
+        info = Gtk.Label(
+            label=(
+                description
+                if description is not None
+                else _(
+                    "Merge duplicate repositories into a single repository, "
+                    "standardize repository names against gold standards, and "
+                    "tidy address details."
+                )
+            ),
+        )
+        info.set_line_wrap(True)
+        info.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        content.add(info)
+
+        if not rows:
+            done = Gtk.Label(
+                label=str(_("No repository consolidation problems found."))
+            )
+            done.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            content.add(done)
+            self.add_button(str(_("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+            return
+
+        header_grid = Gtk.Grid()
+        header_grid.set_column_spacing(0)
+        header_grid.set_row_spacing(0)
+        header_grid.set_column_homogeneous(True)
+        header_grid.set_hexpand(True)
+        header_grid.set_vexpand(False)
+        header_grid.get_style_context().add_class("merge-grid")
+
+        repo_head = Gtk.Label()
+        repo_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Repository")))
+        repo_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        repo_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        source_head = Gtk.Label()
+        source_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Sources")))
+        source_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        source_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        mid_head = Gtk.Label()
+        mid_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Consolidate into (target)")))
+        mid_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        mid_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        hint_head = Gtk.Label()
+        hint_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Hint")))
+        hint_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        hint_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        for head in (repo_head, source_head, mid_head, hint_head):
+            head.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+        header_grid.attach(repo_head, 0, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(source_head, 1, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(mid_head, 2, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(hint_head, 3, 0, 1, 1)
+        content.add(header_grid)
+
+        content.pack_start(self.build_rows(rows), True, True, 0)
+
+        hint = Gtk.Label(
+            label=str(
+                _(
+                    "Merging combines duplicate repositories into one and updates "
+                    "all referencing sources; gold-standard targets add official "
+                    "repository type and web address."
+                )
+            )
+        )
+        hint.set_line_wrap(True)
+        hint.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        content.add(hint)
+
+        n_hints = sum(1 for row, _combo in self.row_combos if row.get("hint_target"))
+        self.accept_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Accept hints (%d)")) % n_hints)
+        self.accept_button.set_sensitive(n_hints > 0)
+        self.accept_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_accept_hints)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.accept_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.apply_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Apply")))
+        self.apply_button.set_sensitive(len(rows) > 0)
+        self.apply_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_apply)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.apply_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.add_button(str(_("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+
+    def _install_grid_css(self) -> None:
+        """Install CSS that draws borders around every grid cell."""
+        if getattr(self, "_grid_css_installed", False):
+            return
+        css = b"""
+        .merge-grid {
+            border: 1px solid #555555;
+            margin: 0;
+        }
+        .merge-cell {
+            border: none;
+            margin: 0;
+            padding: 2px;
+        }
+        """
+        screen = Gdk.Screen.get_default()
+        if screen is None:
+            return
+        provider = Gtk.CssProvider()
+        provider.load_from_data(css)
+        Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_screen(
+            screen,
+            provider,
+            Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION,
+        )
+        self._grid_css_installed = True
+
+    def _make_combo(self, row: dict[str, Any]) -> Gtk.ComboBox:
+        """Create a target dropdown for a repository row."""
+        store = Gtk.ListStore(str, str)
+        for opt_label, opt_val in row.get("options", []):
+            store.append([opt_label, opt_val])
+
+        combo = Gtk.ComboBox.new_with_model(store)
+        combo.set_hexpand(False)
+        combo.set_size_request(240, -1)
+        renderer = Gtk.CellRendererText()
+        renderer.set_property("wrap-mode", 2)
+        renderer.set_property("width-chars", 40)
+        renderer.set_property("ellipsize", Pango.EllipsizeMode.END)
+        combo.pack_start(renderer, True)
+        combo.add_attribute(renderer, "text", 0)
+        combo.set_active(0)
+        combo._user_target = row["handle"]
+        combo.connect("changed", self._on_combo_changed)
+        return combo
+
+    def _on_combo_changed(self, combo: Gtk.ComboBox) -> None:
+        """Record the user's current selection on the combo object itself."""
+        iter_ = combo.get_active_iter()
+        if iter_ is not None:
+            model = combo.get_model()
+            combo._user_target = str(model.get_value(iter_, 1) or "")
+        else:
+            combo._user_target = ""
+
+    def build_rows(self, rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Gtk.ScrolledWindow:
+        """Build the data grid inside a scrolled window."""
+        self._install_grid_css()
+        grid = Gtk.Grid()
+        grid.set_column_spacing(0)
+        grid.set_row_spacing(0)
+        grid.set_column_homogeneous(True)
+        grid.set_hexpand(True)
+        grid.set_vexpand(True)
+        grid.get_style_context().add_class("merge-grid")
+
+        row_index = 0
+        for row in rows:
+            repo_label = Gtk.Label(label=row["display"])
+            repo_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            repo_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+            repo_label.set_max_width_chars(35)
+            repo_label.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+            grid.attach(repo_label, 0, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            src_label = Gtk.Label(label=row.get("sources_summary", ""))
+            src_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            src_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+            src_label.set_max_width_chars(50)
+            src_label.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+            grid.attach(src_label, 1, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            combo = self._make_combo(row)
+            combo.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+            grid.attach(combo, 2, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            hint_text = row.get("hint_display", "")
+            hint_label = Gtk.Label(label=hint_text)
+            hint_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            hint_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+            hint_label.set_max_width_chars(40)
+            hint_label.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+            grid.attach(hint_label, 3, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            self.combos.append((row["handle"], combo, str(row.get("hint_target", ""))))
+            self.row_combos.append((row, combo))
+            row_index += 1
+
+        scrolled = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
+        scrolled.set_min_content_height(330)
+        scrolled.set_min_content_width(1330)
+        scrolled.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC, Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)
+        scrolled.set_hexpand(True)
+        scrolled.set_vexpand(True)
+        scrolled.add(grid)
+        return scrolled
+
+    def get_choice(self, combo: Gtk.ComboBox, fallback: str) -> str:
+        """Return the target handle/value behind a dropdown row."""
+        user_target = getattr(combo, "_user_target", None)
+        if user_target:
+            return user_target
+        active = combo.get_active()
+        if active < 0:
+            return fallback
+        model = combo.get_model()
+        return str(model[active][1] or fallback)
+
+    def get_choices(self) -> dict[str, str]:
+        """Return mapping of repository handle to chosen target value."""
+        return {
+            row["handle"]: self.get_choice(combo, row["handle"])
+            for row, combo in self.row_combos
+        }
+
+    def cb_accept_hints(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        """Set each unchanged drop-down to its hint target."""
+        accepted = 0
+        for row, combo in self.row_combos:
+            target = row.get("hint_target")
+            if not target:
+                continue
+            original = row["handle"]
+            if self.get_choice(combo, original) != original:
+                continue
+            for index, model_row in enumerate(combo.get_model()):
+                if str(model_row[1]) == target:
+                    combo.set_active(index)
+                    combo._user_target = target
+                    accepted += 1
+                    break
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Hints accepted")),
+            str(
+                _(
+                    "Set %d drop-downs to the suggested repository. Review "
+                    "them, change any that look wrong, then press Apply."
+                )
+            )
+            % accepted,
+            parent=self,
+        )
+
+    def _resolve_golden_keeper(self, db: Any, golden_name: str) -> str | None:
+        """Return the handle for a golden repository, creating it if needed.
+
+        :param db: The database.
+        :param golden_name: The gold-standard repository name.
+        :returns: The repository handle, or ``None`` on failure.
+        """
+        # Already exists in the database?
+        for handle in db.get_repository_handles():
+            repo = db.get_repository_from_handle(handle)
+            if repo is not None and repo.get_name() == golden_name:
+                return handle
+        # Create it within a transaction.
+        try:
+            with DbTxn(_("Create repository"), db) as trans:
+                return self.engine._create_repository(db, golden_name, trans)
+        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Failed to create golden repository %s", golden_name)
+            return None
+
+    def _tidy_keeper_address(self, keeper_handle: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """Clean address lines on the surviving repository.
+
+        An address line that only repeats the repository name is removed.
+        When it is the name followed by extra text (for example
+        "Registries (Genoa, IT / Broward County, FL)"), the extra text is
+        saved in a repository note so the detail is kept, and the address
+        line is cleared. Real addresses are left alone.
+
+        :returns: ``(removed, moved)`` counts.
+        """
+        db = self.dbstate.db
+        repo = db.get_repository_from_handle(keeper_handle)
+        if repo is None:
+            return 0, 0
+        name = repo.get_name() or ""
+        removed = moved = 0
+        kept = []
+        details: list[str] = []
+        for addr in repo.get_address_list():
+            action, detail = classify_repo_street(name, addr.get_street())
+            if action == "keep":
+                kept.append(addr)
+                continue
+            if action == "move":
+                details.append(detail)
+            addr.set_street("")
+            others = (
+                addr.get_locality(),
+                addr.get_city(),
+                addr.get_county(),
+                addr.get_state(),
+                addr.get_country(),
+                addr.get_postal_code(),
+                addr.get_phone(),
+            )
+            done.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            content.add(done)
+            self.add_button(str(_("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+            return
+
+        header_grid = Gtk.Grid()
+        header_grid.set_column_spacing(0)
+        header_grid.set_row_spacing(0)
+        header_grid.set_column_homogeneous(True)
+        header_grid.set_hexpand(True)
+        header_grid.set_vexpand(False)
+        header_grid.get_style_context().add_class("merge-grid")
+
+        repo_head = Gtk.Label()
+        repo_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Repository")))
+        repo_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        repo_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        source_head = Gtk.Label()
+        source_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Sources")))
+        source_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        source_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        mid_head = Gtk.Label()
+        mid_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Consolidate into (target)")))
+        mid_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        mid_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        hint_head = Gtk.Label()
+        hint_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Hint")))
+        hint_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        hint_head.set_hexpand(True)
+
+        for head in (repo_head, source_head, mid_head, hint_head):
+            head.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+        header_grid.attach(repo_head, 0, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(source_head, 1, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(mid_head, 2, 0, 1, 1)
+        header_grid.attach(hint_head, 3, 0, 1, 1)
+        content.add(header_grid)
+
+        content.pack_start(self.build_rows(rows), True, True, 0)
+
+        hint = Gtk.Label(
+            label=str(
+                _(
+                    "Merging combines duplicate repositories into one and updates "
+                    "all referencing sources; gold-standard targets add official "
+                    "repository type and web address."
+                )
+            )
+        )
+        hint.set_line_wrap(True)
+        hint.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        content.add(hint)
+
+        n_hints = sum(1 for row, _combo in self.row_combos if row.get("hint_target"))
+        self.accept_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Accept hints (%d)")) % n_hints)
+        self.accept_button.set_sensitive(n_hints > 0)
+        self.accept_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_accept_hints)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.accept_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.apply_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Apply")))
+        self.apply_button.set_sensitive(len(rows) > 0)
+        self.apply_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_apply)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.apply_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.add_button(str(_("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+

+    def merge(self, keeper_handle: str, discard_handle: str) -> bool:
+        """Merge discard repository into keeper repository."""
+        return self.engine.merge_repositories(
+            self.dbstate.db, keeper_handle, discard_handle
+        )
+
+    def cb_apply(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        """Apply chosen repository consolidations."""
+        changes: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+        for row, combo in self.row_combos:
+            chosen = self.get_choice(combo, row["handle"])
+            if chosen and chosen != row["handle"]:
+                changes.append((row["handle"], chosen))
+
+        if not changes:
+            OkDialog(
+                str(_("Nothing to consolidate")),
+                str(
+                    _(
+                        "Every drop-down is still on its first entry. Pick a "
+                        "target in one or more rows, then press Apply."
+                    )
+                ),
+                parent=self,
+            )
+            return
+
+        result = apply_repo_consolidations(self.dbstate.db, changes, self.engine)
+        self._show_result(result, str(_("Repositories Consolidated")))
+
+    def _show_result(self, result: dict[str, Any], ok_title: str) -> None:
+        """Summarize an ``apply_repo_consolidations`` result."""
+        summary_parts = []
+        if result["merged"] > 0:
+            summary_parts.append(
+                str(_("Consolidated %d repositories.")) % result["merged"]
+            )
+        if result["created"] > 0:
+            summary_parts.append(
+                str(_("Created %d gold-standard repositories.")) % result["created"]
+            )
+        if result["removed"] > 0:
+            summary_parts.append(
+                str(_("Removed %d redundant address lines.")) % result["removed"]
+            )
+        if result["moved"] > 0:
+            summary_parts.append(
+                str(_("Moved %d place details into notes.")) % result["moved"]
+            )
+        msg = (
+            " ".join(summary_parts)
+            if summary_parts
+            else str(_("Consolidation complete."))
+        )
+        if result["errors"]:
+            ErrorDialog(
+                str(_("Consolidate warnings")),
+                msg + "\n\n" + "\n".join(result["errors"]),
+                parent=self,
+            )
+        else:
+            OkDialog(ok_title, msg, parent=self)
+
+    def run_auto(self, parent: Gtk.Window | None = None) -> None:
+        """Accept all hints and apply them (same code as Accept all hints)."""
+        owner = parent or self.get_transient_for()
+        result = auto_consolidate_repositories(self.dbstate.db, self.engine)
+        message = str(_("Consolidated %d repositories.")) % result["merged"]
+        if result["errors"]:
+            ErrorDialog(
+                str(_("Auto fix: repositories")),
+                message + "\n\n" + "\n".join(result["errors"]),
+                parent=owner,
+            )
+            return
+        OkDialog(str(_("Auto fix: repositories")), message, parent=owner)
+
+    def show_dialog(self) -> None:
+        """Show and run the modal dialog until user explicitly closes it."""
+        self.show_all()
+        while True:
+            resp = self.run()
+            if resp in (
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CANCEL,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.DELETE_EVENT,
+            ):
+                break
+        self.destroy()
+
+    def run_auto(self, parent: Gtk.Window | None = None) -> None:
+        """Run the best-guess auto consolidation by accepting all hints and applying."""
+        rows = build_repo_consolidate_rows(self.dbstate.db)
+        owner = parent or self.get_transient_for()
+        db = self.dbstate.db
+        merged_count = 0
+        for row in rows:
+            target = row.get("hint_target")
+            if not target:
+                continue
+            discard_handle = row["handle"]
+            if target.startswith("GOLDEN:"):
+                keeper_handle = self._resolve_golden_keeper(db, target[7:])
+            else:
+                keeper_handle = target
+            if keeper_handle and keeper_handle != discard_handle:
+                if self.merge(keeper_handle, discard_handle):
+                    merged_count += 1
+                    self._tidy_keeper_address(keeper_handle)
+
+        try:
+            self.engine.apply_gold_standard_details(db)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Auto fix: repositories")),
+            str(_("Consolidated %d repositories.")) % merged_count,
+            parent=owner,
+        )
+
+    def show_dialog(self) -> None:
+        """Show and run the modal dialog until user explicitly closes it."""
+        self.show_all()
+        while True:
+            resp = self.run()
+            if resp in (
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CANCEL,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.DELETE_EVENT,
+            ):
+                break
+        self.destroy()
