+from gi.repository import Gtk
+from gi.repository import Pango
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# Gramps modules
+#
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+from gramps.gen.db import DbTxn
+from gramps.gen.const import GRAMPS_LOCALE as glocale
+from gramps.gui.dialog import ErrorDialog, OkDialog
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gw_goldstandardrepos import GoldStandardRepositories
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardcitationshared import (
+    build_family_titles,
+    build_title_repo_index,
+    suggest_repository,
+)
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardcitationrepairengine import (
+    GWizardCitationRepairEngine,
+)
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardcitationfix import (
+    UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY,
+    auto_assign_source_repositories,
+    build_repo_merge_rows,
+    collect_sources_by_repo,
+    get_fix_description,
+    get_golden_repo_display,
+    plan_repo_merges,
+)
+
+_ = glocale.translation.sgettext
+LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# RepoMergeDialog
+#
+# ------------------------------------------------------------
+class RepoMergeDialog(Gtk.Dialog):
+    """Grid dialog: repository names (with merge target dropdowns) beside
+    their associated sources. The header shares the grid columns with the
+    rows below so they align vertically, and cell text wraps to stay inside
+    its column."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        title: str,
+        dbstate: Any,
+        description: str | None = None,
+        transient_for: Gtk.Window | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Build the merge dialog for repositories needing fixes."""
+        super().__init__(
+            title=title,
+            transient_for=transient_for,
+            modal=True,
+            destroy_with_parent=True,
+        )
+        self.dbstate = dbstate
+        self.combos: list[tuple[str, Gtk.ComboBox, str]] = []
+        # One (row info, combo) pair per grid row; Apply reads these.
+        self.row_targets: list[tuple[dict[str, str], Gtk.ComboBox]] = []
+        self.set_default_size(1480, 420)
+        content = self.get_content_area()
+        content.set_border_width(12)
+        content.set_spacing(6)
+
+        # Collect repository rows and associated sources.
+        self.sources_by_repo = self.collect_sources_by_repo()
+        self.source_rows = self.collect_source_rows()
+        linked_rows = [row for row in self.source_rows if row["repo_handle"]]
+        self.hint_index = build_title_repo_index(linked_rows)
+        # Titles of every source, linked or not, grouped by collection so a
+        # title without "U.S." can follow its "U.S." twin.
+        self.family_titles = build_family_titles(
+            [row["title"] for row in self.source_rows]
+        )
+        rows = build_repo_merge_rows(self.collect_repo_names())
+        visible = [row for row in rows if not row["skip"]]
+
+        # Count header in the content area.
+        n_repos = len(visible)
+        n_sources = sum(len(titles) for titles in self.sources_by_repo.values())
+        count_label = Gtk.Label()
+        count_label.set_markup(
+            "<b>%s</b>"
+            % str(
+                _("Repositories (%d total), Sources (%d total)") % (n_repos, n_sources)
+            )
+        )
+        count_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        count_label.set_hexpand(True)
+        content.add(count_label)
+
+        if not visible and not self.sources_by_repo.get(UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY):
+            done = Gtk.Label(
+                label=str(_("All repositories already match golden names."))
+            )
+            done.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            content.add(done)
+            self.accept_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Accept hints (%d)")) % 0)
+            self.accept_button.set_sensitive(False)
+            self.add_action_widget(self.accept_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+            self.apply_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Apply")))
+            self.apply_button.set_sensitive(False)
+            self.add_action_widget(self.apply_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+            self.add_button(str(_("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+            return
+        # Add header row above the scrolled grid so it stays locked
+        # when scrolling through the data rows.
+        header_grid = Gtk.Grid()
+        header_grid.set_column_spacing(0)
+        header_grid.set_row_spacing(0)
+        header_grid.set_column_homogeneous(True)
+        header_grid.set_hexpand(True)
+        header_grid.set_vexpand(False)
+        header_grid.get_style_context().add_class("merge-grid")
+        self.build_header(header_grid)
+        content.add(header_grid)
+
+        content.pack_start(
+            self.build_rows(visible, self.sources_by_repo), True, True, 0
+        )
+        desc_text = (
+            description
+            if description is not None
+            else get_fix_description("repositories")
+        )
+        hint_footer = Gtk.Label(
+            label=f"{desc_text} "
+            + str(
+                _(
+                    "Golden entries show their description and URL "
+                    "to help you pick the right target."
+                )
+            )
+        )
+        hint_footer.set_line_wrap(True)
+        hint_footer.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        hint_footer.set_size_request(-1, 45)
+        content.pack_start(hint_footer, False, False, 0)
+
+        n_hints = sum(1 for info, _combo in self.row_targets if info.get("hint_target"))
+        self.accept_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Accept hints (%d)")) % n_hints)
+        self.accept_button.set_sensitive(n_hints > 0)
+        self.accept_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_accept_hints)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.accept_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.apply_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Apply")))
+        has_items = bool(visible or self.sources_by_repo.get(UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY))
+        self.apply_button.set_sensitive(has_items)
+        self.apply_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_apply)
+        self.add_action_widget(self.apply_button, Gtk.ResponseType.NONE)
+
+        self.add_button(str(_("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+
+    def collect_sources_by_repo(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+        """Return repository name mapped to sorted source titles it references."""
+        return collect_sources_by_repo(self.dbstate.db)
+
+    def collect_source_rows(self) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+        """Return one row per source/repository pair, keeping the handles.
+
+        Each row holds ``source_handle``, ``title``, ``repo_handle`` (empty
+        when the source has no usable repository) and ``repo_name`` (the
+        repository name, or ``UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY``). A source linked to
+        several repositories appears once for each.
+        """
+        db = self.dbstate.db
+        handle_to_name: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for repo in db.iter_repositories():
+            try:
+                name = str(repo.get_name() or "")
+                if name:
+                    handle_to_name[str(repo.get_handle() or "")] = name
+            except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+                LOG.exception("Failed to read repository")
+        rows: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+        for source in db.iter_sources():
+            try:
+                title = str(source.get_title() or "")
+                source_handle = str(source.get_handle() or "")
+                refs = [
+                    str(ref.get_reference_handle() or "")
+                    for ref in source.get_reporef_list()
+                ]
+                if not refs:
+                    refs = [""]
+                for ref_handle in refs:
+                    name = handle_to_name.get(ref_handle, "")
+                    rows.append(
+                        {
+                            "source_handle": source_handle,
+                            "title": title,
+                            "repo_handle": ref_handle if name else "",
+                            "repo_name": name or UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY,
+                        }
+                    )
+            except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+                LOG.exception("Failed to read source")
+        return rows
+
+    def build_header(self, grid: Gtk.Grid) -> None:
+        """Add the header row to the repository/source grid.
+
+        The header lives in the same grid as the data rows so the column
+        edges line up vertically instead of being allocated by separate
+        containers.  The "Sources" column is now the first column.
+        """
+        # Column 0: Sources (moved from position 2)
+        sources_head = Gtk.Label()
+        sources_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Sources")))
+        sources_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        sources_head.set_hexpand(True)
+        # Column 1: Repository (moved from position 0)
+        left_head = Gtk.Label()
+        left_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Repository")))
+        left_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        left_head.set_hexpand(True)
+        # Column 2: Merge into (golden) (moved from position 1)
+        mid_head = Gtk.Label()
+        mid_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Merge into (golden)")))
+        mid_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        mid_head.set_hexpand(True)
+        # Column 3: Hint (kept at position 3)
+        hint_head = Gtk.Label()
+        hint_head.set_markup("<b>%s</b>" % str(_("Hint")))
+        hint_head.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+        hint_head.set_hexpand(True)
+        for head in (sources_head, left_head, mid_head, hint_head):
+            head.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+        grid.attach(sources_head, 0, 0, 1, 1)
+        grid.attach(left_head, 1, 0, 1, 1)
+        grid.attach(mid_head, 2, 0, 1, 1)
+        grid.attach(hint_head, 3, 0, 1, 1)
+
+    def _install_grid_css(self) -> None:
+        """Install CSS that draws borders around every grid cell.
+
+        Gtk.Grid has no native "show grid lines" option, so each cell
+        widget gets a thin border so columns and rows are visually
+        separated and line up with the header above them.
+        """
+        if getattr(self, "_grid_css_installed", False):
+            return
+        css = b"""
+        .merge-grid {
+            border: 1px solid #555555;
+            margin: 0;
+        }
+        .merge-cell {
+            border: none;
+            margin: 0;
+            padding: 2px;
+        }
+        """
+        screen = Gdk.Screen.get_default()
+        if screen is None:
+            return
+        provider = Gtk.CssProvider()
+        provider.load_from_data(css)
+        Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_screen(
+            screen,
+            provider,
+            Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION,
+        )
+        self._grid_css_installed = True
+
+    def _install_grid_css(self) -> None:
+        """Install CSS that draws borders around every grid cell.
+
+        Gtk.Grid has no native "show grid lines" option, so each cell
+        widget gets a thin border so columns and rows are visually
+        separated and line up with the header above them.
+        """
+        if getattr(self, "_grid_css_installed", False):
+            return
+        css = b"""
+        .merge-grid {
+            border: 1px solid #555555;
+            margin: 0;
+        }
+        .merge-cell {
+            border: none;
+            margin: 0;
+            padding: 2px;
+        }
+        """
+        provider = Gtk.CssProvider()
+        provider.load_from_data(css)
+        Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_screen(
+            screen,
+            provider,
+            Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION,
+        )
+        self._grid_css_installed = True
+
+    def _make_combo(self, row: dict[str, Any]) -> Gtk.ComboBox:
+        """Create a golden-target dropdown for a repository row.
+
+        Column 0 is the visible label; column 1 is the raw repository name
+        used when applying the choice. The dropdown lists the source's
+        repository name first (the bypass entry) followed by every
+        golden-list entry; golden entries show their description and URL
+        to help pick the right target.
+        """
+        store = Gtk.ListStore(str, str)
+        # Bypass entry: the source's own repository name.
+        store.append([row["name"], row["name"]])
+        # Golden entries: show description + URL, store the raw name.
+        for option in row["options"][1:]:
+            store.append([get_golden_repo_display(option), option])
+        combo = Gtk.ComboBox.new_with_model(store)
+        combo.set_hexpand(False)
+        # Narrow the combo + dropdown to ~300px so columns stay compact.
+        combo.set_size_request(210, -1)
+        renderer = Gtk.CellRendererText()
+        renderer.set_property("wrap-mode", 2)
+        # Truncate displayed entries with "..." when they exceed this many chars.
+        renderer.set_property("width-chars", 40)
+        renderer.set_property("ellipsize", Pango.EllipsizeMode.END)
+        combo.pack_start(renderer, True)
+        combo.add_attribute(renderer, "text", 0)
+        combo.set_active(0)
+        # Store the user's selection directly on the combo object so Apply
+        # always reads the current value, regardless of GTK timing issues
+        # with get_active().
+        combo._user_target = row["name"]
+        combo.connect("changed", self._on_combo_changed)
+        return combo
+
+    def _on_combo_changed(self, combo: Gtk.ComboBox) -> None:
+        """Record the user's current selection on the combo object itself."""
+        iter_ = combo.get_active_iter()
+        if iter_ is not None:
+            model = combo.get_model()
+            combo._user_target = str(model.get_value(iter_, 1) or "")
+        else:
+            combo._user_target = ""
+
+    def compute_hint(
+        self, repo_name: str, info: dict[str, str], combo: Gtk.ComboBox
+    ) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
+        """Return ``(golden repository, reason)`` suggested for a grid row."""
+        offered = {str(row[1]) for row in combo.get_model()}
+        golden = [
+            name for name in GoldStandardRepositories.get_names() if name in offered
+        ]
+        current = "" if repo_name == UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY else repo_name
+        return suggest_repository(
+            info.get("title", ""),
+            info.get("source_handle", ""),
+            current,
+            self.hint_index,
+            golden,
+            self.family_titles,
+        )
+
+    def attach_hint(
+        self, info: dict[str, str], repo_name: str, combo: Gtk.ComboBox
+    ) -> str:
+        """Record the hint on the row info and return the text to display."""
+        found = self.compute_hint(repo_name, info, combo)
+        if found is None:
+            info["hint_target"] = ""
+            return ""
+        info["hint_target"], info["hint_reason"] = found
+        return "%s\n(%s)" % found
+
+    def build_rows(
+        self,
+        visible: list[dict[str, Any]],
+        sources_by_repo: dict[str, list[str]],
+    ) -> Gtk.ScrolledWindow:
+        """Build a grid: header row plus repositories (left) with merge
+        dropdowns (middle) and associated sources (right), grouped by
+        repository with empty rows last. The header shares the same grid
+        columns as the cells below so they align vertically, and cell
+        text wraps so long values stay inside their columns."""
+        self._install_grid_css()
+        grid = Gtk.Grid()
+        grid.set_column_spacing(0)
+        grid.set_row_spacing(0)
+        grid.set_column_homogeneous(True)
+        grid.set_hexpand(True)
+        grid.set_vexpand(True)
+        grid.get_style_context().add_class("merge-grid")
+
+        # Sort: repositories with sources first (alphabetical), then those
+        # without sources (alphabetical) so empty rows appear last.
+        with_sources = [r for r in visible if sources_by_repo.get(r["name"], [])]
+        without_sources = [r for r in visible if not sources_by_repo.get(r["name"], [])]
+        sorted_rows = with_sources + without_sources
+
+        # Build a flat list of (repo_name, source_title) pairs, one row per source.
+        # Each repo with sources gets one row per source; repos without sources
+        # get a single row with the "(no sources)" placeholder.
+        rows_by_repo: dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]] = defaultdict(list)
+        for info in getattr(self, "source_rows", None) or self.collect_source_rows():
+            rows_by_repo[info["repo_name"]].append(info)
+        for infos in rows_by_repo.values():
+            infos.sort(key=lambda item: item["title"].lower())
+
+        # (repo_name, source_title, row info); info is None for a repository
+        # that has no sources.
+        flat_rows: list[tuple[str, str, dict[str, str] | None]] = []
+        for repo_name in [r["name"] for r in sorted_rows]:
+            infos = rows_by_repo.get(repo_name, [])
+            if infos:
+                for info in infos:
+                    flat_rows.append((repo_name, info["title"], info))
+            else:
+                # Repo with no sources: one row showing the placeholder.
+                flat_rows.append((repo_name, "(no sources)", None))
+
+        # Append unattached sources (no repository reference) as final rows.
+        for info in rows_by_repo.get(UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY, []):
+            flat_rows.append((UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY, info["title"], info))
+
+        # Row 0 is the header; data rows start below it. Each source entry
+        # gets its own row with its own merge-target dropdown (Option 2).
+        # Column 0: source title for this row (moved from column 2).
+        # Column 1: repository name label (moved from column 0).
+        # Column 2: one combo per source row, with the original name first
+        #   as the bypass option, then golden repo names.
+        # Column 3: hint for this row (kept at column 3).
+        row_index = 1
+        for repo_name, source_title, info in flat_rows:
+            # Column 0: the source title for this row.
+            if source_title == "(no sources)":
+                placeholder = Gtk.Label(label=str(_("(no sources)")))
+                placeholder.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+                placeholder.set_line_wrap(True)
+                placeholder.set_max_width_chars(60)
+                placeholder.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+                grid.attach(placeholder, 0, row_index, 1, 1)
+            elif source_title == "(no repository)":
+                placeholder = Gtk.Label(label=str(_("(no repository)")))
+                placeholder.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+                placeholder.set_line_wrap(True)
+                placeholder.set_max_width_chars(60)
+                placeholder.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+                grid.attach(placeholder, 0, row_index, 1, 1)
+            else:
+                src_label = Gtk.Label(label=source_title)
+                src_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+                src_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+                src_label.set_max_width_chars(60)
+                src_label.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+                grid.attach(src_label, 0, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            # Column 1: repository name label for this row.
+            repo_label = Gtk.Label(label=repo_name)
+            repo_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            repo_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+            repo_label.set_max_width_chars(60)
+            repo_label.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+            grid.attach(repo_label, 1, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            # Column 2: a separate merge-target combobox for this source row.
+            # Find the row dict for this repo to build the combo.
+            if repo_name == UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY:
+                # Unattached sources have no repo; show golden repo names
+                # so the user can assign a repository to the source.
+                golden = GoldStandardRepositories.get_names()
+                row_dict = {
+                    "name": UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY,
+                    "options": [UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY] + golden,
+                    "best_guess": UNATTACHED_REPO_KEY,
+                }
+            else:
+                row_dict = next(r for r in sorted_rows if r["name"] == repo_name)
+            combo = self._make_combo(row_dict)
+            combo.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+            grid.attach(combo, 2, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            # Column 3: hint for this row (suggested repository and why).
+            row_info = (
+                info
+                if info is not None
+                else {"source_handle": "", "repo_handle": "", "repo_name": repo_name}
+            )
+            hint_label = Gtk.Label(label=self.attach_hint(row_info, repo_name, combo))
+            hint_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            hint_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+            hint_label.set_max_width_chars(40)
+            hint_label.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+            grid.attach(hint_label, 3, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            # Column 3: hint for this row (suggested repository and why).
+            row_info = (
+                info
+                if info is not None
+                else {"source_handle": "", "repo_handle": "", "repo_name": repo_name}
+            )
+            hint_label = Gtk.Label(label=self.attach_hint(row_info, repo_name, combo))
+            hint_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            hint_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+            hint_label.set_max_width_chars(40)
+            hint_label.get_style_context().add_class("merge-cell")
+            grid.attach(hint_label, 3, row_index, 1, 1)
+
+            # Track the combo per grid row for later retrieval of choices.
+            self.combos.append((repo_name, combo, str(row_dict["best_guess"])))
+            self.row_targets.append((row_info, combo))
+            row_index += 1
+
+        scrolled = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
+        scrolled.set_min_content_height(330)
+        scrolled.set_min_content_width(1330)
+        scrolled.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC, Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)
+        scrolled.set_hexpand(True)
+        scrolled.set_vexpand(True)
+        scrolled.add(grid)
+        return scrolled
+
+    def build_buttons(self) -> Gtk.Box:
+        """Return the repository action button row."""
+        buttons = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
+        buttons.set_homogeneous(True)
+        n_hints = sum(1 for info, _combo in self.row_targets if info.get("hint_target"))
+        accept_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Accept hints (%d)")) % n_hints)
+        accept_button.set_sensitive(n_hints > 0)
+        accept_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_accept_hints)
+        apply_button = Gtk.Button(label=str(_("Apply")))
+        apply_button.connect("clicked", self.cb_apply)
+        buttons.pack_start(accept_button, True, True, 0)
+        buttons.pack_start(apply_button, True, True, 0)
+        return buttons
+
+    def collect_repo_names(self) -> list[str]:
+        """Return sorted repository names from the database."""
+        names: list[str] = []
+        try:
+            for repo in self.dbstate.db.iter_repositories():
+                try:
+                    name = str(repo.get_name() or "")
+                except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+                    name = ""
+                names.append(name or str(_("Unnamed repository")))
+        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Failed to collect repositories")
+        return sorted(names)
+
+    def find_repository_by_name(self, name: str) -> Any | None:
+        """Return the first repository matching a name, or None."""
+        try:
+            for repo in self.dbstate.db.iter_repositories():
+                try:
+                    if str(repo.get_name() or "") == name:
+                        return repo
+                except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+                    continue
+        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Failed to find repository %s", name)
+        return None
+
+    def get_choice(self, combo: Gtk.ComboBox, fallback: str) -> str:
+        """Return the golden repository name behind a dropdown row."""
+        # Read the selection captured by the "changed" signal, stored on
+        # the combo object itself. This avoids GTK timing issues where
+        # get_active() may not reflect the user's latest choice.
+        user_target = getattr(combo, "_user_target", None)
+        if user_target:
+            return user_target
+        active = combo.get_active()
+        if active < 0:
+            return fallback
+        model = combo.get_model()
+        return str(model[active][1] or fallback)
+
+    def get_choices(self) -> dict[str, str]:
+        """Return the current original->target choice for every row."""
+        return {
+            name: self.get_choice(combo, name) for name, combo, _best in self.combos
+        }
+
+    def apply_merges(self, plan: dict[str, list[str]]) -> tuple[int, int, list[str]]:
+        """Apply repository merges/renames from a target->originals plan.
+
+        Returns (merged_count, renamed_count, error_messages).
+        """
+        from gramps.gen.merge import MergeRepositoryQuery
+
+        merged = 0
+        renamed = 0
+        errors: list[str] = []
+        db = self.dbstate.db
+        for target_name, originals in plan.items():
+            for original in originals:
+                try:
+                    target = self.find_repository_by_name(target_name)
+                    source = self.find_repository_by_name(original)
+                    if source is None:
+                        errors.append(
+                            str(
+                                _("Repository '%(original)s' not found in " "database.")
+                                % {"original": original}
+                            )
+                        )
+                        continue
+                    if target is None:
+                        with DbTxn(
+                            str(_("Rename Repository")), db, batch=True
+                        ) as trans:
+                            source.set_name(target_name)
+                            db.commit_repository(source, trans)
+                        renamed += 1
+                    else:
+                        if source.get_handle() == target.get_handle():
+                            continue
+                        query = MergeRepositoryQuery(self.dbstate, target, source)
+                        query.execute()
+                        merged += 1
+                except Exception as error:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+                    LOG.exception("Failed to merge repository %s", original)
+                    errors.append(
+                        str(
+                            _("Failed to merge repository '%(original)s': " "%(error)s")
+                            % {
+                                "original": original,
+                                "error": str(error),
+                            }
+                        )
+                    )
+        return (merged, renamed, errors)
+
+    def run_auto(self, parent: Gtk.Window | None = None) -> None:
+        """Accept every hint and apply it (same code as Accept all hints)."""
+        owner = parent or self.get_transient_for()
+        try:
+            changed, created = auto_assign_source_repositories(
+                GWizardCitationRepairEngine(), self.dbstate.db
+            )
+        except Exception as error:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Auto fix of repositories failed")
+            ErrorDialog(str(_("Auto fix: repositories")), str(error), parent=owner)
+            return
+        message = str(_("Changed the repository of %d sources")) % changed
+        if created:
+            message += str(_(" (%d new repositories created)")) % created
+        OkDialog(str(_("Auto fix: repositories")), message + ".", parent=owner)
+
+    def show_dialog(self) -> None:
+        """Show the dialog modally and destroy it afterwards.
+
+        Accept/Apply return ``ResponseType.NONE`` and must keep the dialog
+        open so the user can review and press Apply; only a close-type
+        response dismisses the dialog.
+        """
+        self.show_all()
+        while True:
+            resp = self.run()
+            if resp in (
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CANCEL,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.DELETE_EVENT,
+            ):
+                break
+        self.destroy()
+
+    def cb_accept_hints(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        """Set each unchanged drop-down to its hint; Apply still has to be pressed."""
+        accepted = 0
+        for info, combo in self.row_targets:
+            target = info.get("hint_target")
+            if not target:
+                continue
+            original = info["repo_name"]
+            # Keep any choice the user already made by hand.
+            if self.get_choice(combo, original) != original:
+                continue
+            for index, model_row in enumerate(combo.get_model()):
+                if str(model_row[1]) == target:
+                    combo.set_active(index)
+                    accepted += 1
+                    break
+        if hasattr(self, "accept_button"):
+            self.accept_button.set_sensitive(False)
+            self.accept_button.set_label(str(_("Accept hints (%d)")) % 0)
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Hints accepted")),
+            str(
+                _(
+                    "Set %d drop-downs to the suggested repository. Review "
+                    "them, change any that look wrong, then press Apply."
+                )
+            )
+            % accepted,
+            parent=self,
+        )
+
+    def collect_changes(
+        self,
+    ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], dict[str, str]]:
+        """Compare every drop-down with its first entry.
+
+        Returns ``(source_changes, repo_changes)``. ``source_changes`` lists
+        the sources whose row was changed; ``repo_changes`` maps a
+        repository that has no sources to its chosen golden target.
+        """
+        source_changes: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+        repo_changes: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for info, combo in self.row_targets:
+            original = info["repo_name"]
+            target = self.get_choice(combo, original)
+            if not target or target == original:
+                continue
+            if info.get("source_handle"):
+                source_changes.append(
+                    {
+                        "source_handle": info["source_handle"],
+                        "old_repo_handle": info.get("repo_handle", ""),
+                        "target_name": target,
+                    }
+                )
+            else:
+                repo_changes[original] = target
+        return source_changes, repo_changes
+
+    def cb_apply(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        """Change the repository of every source whose drop-down was changed."""
+        source_changes, repo_changes = self.collect_changes()
+        if not source_changes and not repo_changes:
+            OkDialog(
+                str(_("Nothing to change")),
+                str(
+                    _(
+                        "Every drop-down is still on its first entry. Pick a "
+                        "repository in one or more rows, then press Apply."
+                    )
+                ),
+                parent=self,
+            )
+            return
+
+        reassigned = created = merged = renamed = 0
+        errors: list[str] = []
+        try:
+            engine = GWizardCitationRepairEngine()
+            reassigned, created = engine.reassign_source_repositories(
+                self.dbstate.db, source_changes
+            )
+            if reassigned < len(source_changes):
+                errors.append(
+                    str(_("%d source(s) could not be changed (see the Gramps log)."))
+                    % (len(source_changes) - reassigned)
+                )
+        except Exception as error:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Failed to change source repositories")
+            errors.append(str(error))
+        if repo_changes:
+            merged, renamed, merge_errors = self.apply_merges(
+                plan_repo_merges(repo_changes)
+            )
+            errors.extend(merge_errors)
+
+        summary = str(_("Changed the repository of %d sources")) % reassigned
+        if created:
+            summary += str(_(" (%d new repositories created)")) % created
+        summary += "."
+        if merged or renamed:
+            summary += "\n" + str(
+                _("Merged %d empty repositories, renamed %d to golden names.")
+                % (merged, renamed)
+            )
+        if errors:
+            ErrorDialog(
+                str(_("Repository changes had problems")),
+                summary + "\n\n" + "\n".join(errors),
+                parent=self,
+            )
+            return
+        OkDialog(str(_("Repositories updated")), summary, parent=self)

+    def _install_grid_css(self) -> None:
+        """Install CSS that draws borders around every grid cell."""
+        if getattr(self, "_grid_css_installed", False):
+            return
+        css = b"""
+        .merge-grid {
+            border: 1px solid #555555;
+            margin: 0;
+        }
+        .merge-cell {
+            border: none;
+            margin: 0;
+            padding: 2px;
+        }
+        """
+        provider = Gtk.CssProvider()
+        provider.load_from_data(css)
+        Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_screen(
+            Gdk.Screen.get_default(),
+            provider,
+            Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION,

+    def _make_combo(self, row: dict[str, Any]) -> Gtk.ComboBox:
+        """
+        Create a target dropdown for a source row.
+
+        Column 0 is the visible label; column 1 is the handle or target value.
+        Option 0 is the source's own database value (bypass / default choice).
+        """
+        store = Gtk.ListStore(str, str)
+        for opt_label, opt_val in row.get("options", []):
+            store.append([opt_label, opt_val])

+        combo = Gtk.ComboBox.new_with_model(store)

+        combo.pack_start(renderer, True)
+        combo.add_attribute(renderer, "text", 0)
+        combo.set_active(0)
+        combo._user_target = row["handle"]
+        combo.connect("changed", self._on_combo_changed)
+        return combo

+            model = combo.get_model()

+        else:
+            combo._user_target = ""

+    def get_choice(self, combo: Gtk.ComboBox, fallback: str) -> str:

+        user_target = getattr(combo, "_user_target", None)
+        if user_target:

+    def get_choices(self) -> dict[str, str]:
+        """Return mapping of source handle to chosen target value."""
+        return {
+            row["handle"]: self.get_choice(combo, row["handle"])

+    def cb_accept_hints(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        """Set each unchanged drop-down to its hint target."""
+        accepted = 0
+        for row, combo in self.row_combos:
+            target = row.get("hint_target")

+            original = row["handle"]

+    def cb_apply(self, _button: Gtk.Button) -> None:
+        """Apply chosen source merges, trims, and quarantines."""
+        rows_with_choices = [
+            dict(row, chosen_target=self.get_choice(combo, row["handle"]))
+            for row, combo in self.row_combos
+        ]
+        plan = plan_source_fixes(rows_with_choices)

+                str(_("No source-record problems to fix.")),
+                parent=self,
+            )
+            return

+        merged, quarantined, trimmed = apply_source_fixes(self.dbstate, plan)
+        msg_parts = []
+        if merged > 0:
+            msg_parts.append(
+                glocale.translation.ngettext(
+                    "merged %d duplicate source",
+                    "merged %d duplicate sources",
+                    merged,

+                glocale.translation.ngettext(
+                    "trimmed %d source", "trimmed %d sources", trimmed
+                )

+        if quarantined > 0:
+            msg_parts.append(
+                glocale.translation.ngettext(
+                    "quarantined %d source", "quarantined %d sources", quarantined
+                )
+                % quarantined
+            )
+        msg = ", ".join(msg_parts).capitalize() + "."
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Source fixes applied")),
+            msg,
+            parent=self,
+        )
+
+    def run_auto(self, parent: Gtk.Window | None = None) -> None:
+        """Run the best-guess auto fix by accepting all hints and applying."""
+        owner = parent or self.get_transient_for()
+        merged, quarantined, trimmed = auto_fix_sources(self.dbstate.db)
+        msg_parts = []
+        if merged > 0:
+            msg_parts.append(
+                glocale.translation.ngettext(
+                    "merged %d duplicate source",
+                    "merged %d duplicate sources",
+                    merged,
+                )
+                % merged
+            )
+        if trimmed > 0:
+            msg_parts.append(
+                glocale.translation.ngettext(
+                    "trimmed %d source", "trimmed %d sources", trimmed
+                )
+                % trimmed
+            )
+        if quarantined > 0:
+            msg_parts.append(
+                glocale.translation.ngettext(
+                    "quarantined %d source", "quarantined %d sources", quarantined
+                )
+                % quarantined
+            )
+        msg = ", ".join(msg_parts).capitalize() + "."
+        OkDialog(
+            str(_("Auto fix: sources")),
+            msg,
+            parent=owner,
+        )
+
+    def show_dialog(self) -> None:
+        """Show and run the modal dialog until user explicitly closes it."""
+        self.show_all()
+        while True:
+            resp = self.run()
+            if resp in (
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.CANCEL,
+                Gtk.ResponseType.DELETE_EVENT,
+            ):
+                break
+        self.destroy()
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------
+#
+# Source fix dialog helpers
+#
+# ------------------------------------------------------------
+def _source_display(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Human-readable label for a source row."""
+    title = row.get("title") or _("(unnamed source)")
+    cites = row.get("citations", 0)
+    cite_str = (
+        glocale.translation.ngettext("%d citation", "%d citations", cites) % cites
+    )
+    if cites == 0:
+        title = _("No citations: ") + title
+    if row.get("repo_count", 0) == 0:
+        title = _("No repository: ") + title
+    return "%s (%s, %s)" % (title, row.get("gramps_id", "??"), cite_str)
+
+
+def _dedupe_handles(handles: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """De-duplicate handles, preserving order."""
+    seen = set()
+    out = []
+    for handle in handles:
+        if handle and handle not in seen:
+            seen.add(handle)
+            out.append(handle)
+    return out
+
+
+def _title_rank(title: Any) -> int:
+    """Return 1 for a title containing "U.S.", the newer database naming."""
+    return 1 if re.search(r"\bU\.S\.", str(title or "")) else 0
+
+
+def _pick_keeper(group: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Pick the preferred keeper for a duplicate group.
+
+    A source with a repository wins, then the title with the newer "U.S."
+    wording, then the one with more citations.
+    """
+    return sorted(
+        group,
+        key=lambda r: (
+            r.get("repo_count", 0),
+            _title_rank(r.get("title")),
+            r.get("citations", 0),
+        ),
+        reverse=True,
+    )[0]
+
+
+def build_source_fix_rows(
+    stats: dict[str, Any], db: Any = None
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Build per-source fix rows from collected database stats."""
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    handled_handles: set[str] = set()
+
+    repo_name_by_handle: dict[str, str] = {}
+    clean_sources_by_title: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    if db:
+        try:
+            for src_h in db.iter_source_handles():
+                src = db.get_source_from_handle(src_h)
+                if src:
+                    s_title = str(src.get_title() or "")
+                    if s_title and s_title == s_title.strip():
+                        clean_sources_by_title[s_title.strip().lower()] = {
+                            "handle": src_h,
+                            "title": s_title,
+                            "gramps_id": str(src.get_gramps_id() or ""),
+                        }
+                    refs = list(src.get_reporef_list())
+                    if refs:
+                        r_h = refs[0].get_reference_handle()
+                        if r_h:
+                            repo = db.get_repository_from_handle(r_h)
+                            if repo:
+                                repo_name_by_handle[src_h] = str(
+                                    repo.get_name() or ""
+                                ).strip()
+        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            pass
+
+    # 1) Near-duplicate groups -> merge action
+    for group in stats.get("near_duplicates", []):
+        group = [r for r in group if r.get("handle")]
+        if len(group) < 2:
+            continue
+        keeper = _pick_keeper(group)
+        keeper_disp = _source_display(keeper)
+
+        for member in group:
+            m_handle = member["handle"]
+            handled_handles.add(m_handle)
+            m_disp = _source_display(member)
+            is_keeper = m_handle == keeper["handle"]
+
+            # Dropdown options: Option 0 is current database value (default)
+            options = [(m_disp, m_handle)]
+            for other in group:
+                if other["handle"] != m_handle:
+                    options.append((_source_display(other), other["handle"]))
+
+            if is_keeper:
+                hint_target = ""
+                hint_reason = ""
+                hint_display = ""
+            else:
+                hint_target = keeper["handle"]
+                if keeper.get("repo_count", 0) > 0 and member.get("repo_count", 0) == 0:
+                    hint_reason = str(_("Keeper has repository"))
+                elif keeper.get("citations", 0) > member.get("citations", 0):
+                    hint_reason = str(
+                        _("Keeper has %d citations") % keeper.get("citations", 0)
+                    )
+                else:
+                    hint_reason = str(_("Preferred keeper"))
+                hint_display = "%s\n(%s)" % (keeper_disp, hint_reason)
+
+            repo_name = repo_name_by_handle.get(m_handle) or (
+                str(_("(no repository)"))
+                if member.get("repo_count", 0) == 0
+                else str(_("Repository"))
+            )
+
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "handle": m_handle,
+                    "title": member.get("title", ""),
+                    "gramps_id": member.get("gramps_id", ""),
+                    "display": m_disp,
+                    "repo_name": repo_name,
+                    "citations": member.get("citations", 0),
+                    "options": options,
+                    "best_guess": m_disp,
+                    "hint_target": hint_target,
+                    "hint_reason": hint_reason,
+                    "hint_display": hint_display,
+                    "problem": "merge",
+                    "is_keeper": is_keeper,
+                    "skip": False,
+                }
+            )
+
+    # 2) Fuzzy title & heuristic similarity matching
+    if db:
+        all_handles: list[str] = []
+        if hasattr(db, "iter_source_handles"):
+            try:
+                all_handles = list(db.iter_source_handles())
+            except Exception:
+                all_handles = []
+        if not all_handles:
+            all_handles = [
+                r["handle"] for r in stats.get("source_rows", []) if r.get("handle")
+            ]
+
+        cites_by_source = {
+            r["handle"]: r.get("citations", 0)
+            for r in stats.get("source_rows", [])
+            if r.get("handle")
+        }
+
+        keeper_rows_by_handle: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
+            r["handle"]: r for r in rows if r.get("is_keeper")
+        }
+
+        for handle in all_handles:
+            if handle in handled_handles:
+                continue
+            match = suggest_source_merge_target(
+                handle, all_handles, db, cites_by_source
+            )
+            if not match:
+                continue
+
+            target_handle, reason = match
+            if target_handle == handle:
+                continue
+
+            target_src = None
+            try:
+                target_src = db.get_source_from_handle(target_handle)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            if target_src is None:
+                continue
+
+            t_disp = _source_display(
+                {
+                    "title": target_src.get_title(),
+                    "gramps_id": target_src.get_gramps_id(),
+                    "citations": cites_by_source.get(target_handle, 0),
+                    "repo_count": len(list(target_src.get_reporef_list() or [])),
+                }
+            )
+
+            src_obj = None
+            try:
+                src_obj = db.get_source_from_handle(handle)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            if src_obj is None:
+                continue
+
+            s_disp = _source_display(
+                {
+                    "title": src_obj.get_title(),
+                    "gramps_id": src_obj.get_gramps_id(),
+                    "citations": cites_by_source.get(handle, 0),
+                    "repo_count": len(list(src_obj.get_reporef_list() or [])),
+                }
+            )
+
+            # Between handle and target_handle, determine the preferred keeper
+            src_score = (
+                len(list(src_obj.get_reporef_list() or [])),
+                _title_rank(src_obj.get_title()),
+                cites_by_source.get(handle, 0),
+            )
+            target_score = (
+                len(list(target_src.get_reporef_list() or [])),
+                _title_rank(target_src.get_title()),
+                cites_by_source.get(target_handle, 0),
+            )
+            if src_score >= target_score:
+                k_handle = handle
+                k_src = src_obj
+                k_disp = s_disp
+                d_handle = target_handle
+                d_src = target_src
+                d_disp = t_disp
+            else:
+                k_handle = target_handle
+                k_src = target_src
+                k_disp = t_disp
+                d_handle = handle
+                d_src = src_obj
+                d_disp = s_disp
+
+            # 1. Add/update keeper row (hint is blank)
+            if k_handle not in handled_handles:
+                k_repo_name = repo_name_by_handle.get(k_handle) or (
+                    str(_("(no repository)"))
+                    if not list(k_src.get_reporef_list() or [])
+                    else str(_("Repository"))
+                )
+                k_row = {
+                    "handle": k_handle,
+                    "title": str(k_src.get_title() or ""),
+                    "gramps_id": str(k_src.get_gramps_id() or ""),
+                    "display": k_disp,
+                    "repo_name": k_repo_name,
+                    "citations": cites_by_source.get(k_handle, 0),
+                    "options": [(k_disp, k_handle), (d_disp, d_handle)],
+                    "best_guess": k_disp,
+                    "hint_target": "",
+                    "hint_reason": "",
+                    "hint_display": "",
+                    "problem": "merge",
+                    "is_keeper": True,
+                    "skip": False,
+                }
+                rows.append(k_row)
+                handled_handles.add(k_handle)
+                keeper_rows_by_handle[k_handle] = k_row
+            else:
+                if k_handle in keeper_rows_by_handle:
+                    k_row = keeper_rows_by_handle[k_handle]
+                    if (d_disp, d_handle) not in k_row["options"]:
+                        k_row["options"].append((d_disp, d_handle))
+
+            # 2. Add duplicate row (hint points to keeper)
+            d_repo_name = repo_name_by_handle.get(d_handle) or (
+                str(_("(no repository)"))
+                if not list(d_src.get_reporef_list() or [])
+                else str(_("Repository"))
+            )
+            d_row = {
+                "handle": d_handle,
+                "title": str(d_src.get_title() or ""),
+                "gramps_id": str(d_src.get_gramps_id() or ""),
+                "display": d_disp,
+                "repo_name": d_repo_name,
+                "citations": cites_by_source.get(d_handle, 0),
+                "options": [(d_disp, d_handle), (k_disp, k_handle)],
+                "best_guess": d_disp,
+                "hint_target": k_handle,
+                "hint_reason": reason,
+                "hint_display": "%s\n(%s)" % (k_disp, reason),
+                "problem": "merge",
+                "is_keeper": False,
+                "skip": False,
+            }
+            rows.append(d_row)
+            handled_handles.add(d_handle)
+
+    # 3) Sources with leading or trailing whitespace
+    for row in stats.get("source_rows", []):
+        handle = row.get("handle")
+        if not handle or handle in handled_handles:
+            continue
+
+        title = str(row.get("title") or "")
+        author = str(row.get("author") or "")
+        pub = str(row.get("publication") or row.get("publication_info") or "")
+        abbr = str(row.get("abbreviation") or "")
+
+        # Also check db object if fields not in row dict
+        if db and not author and not pub and not abbr:
+            try:
+                src_obj = db.get_source_from_handle(handle)
+                if src_obj:
+                    title = str(src_obj.get_title() or "")
+                    author = str(src_obj.get_author() or "")
+                    pub = str(src_obj.get_publication_info() or "")
+                    abbr = str(src_obj.get_abbreviation() or "")
+            except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+                pass
+
+        ws_fields = []
+        if title != title.strip():
+            ws_fields.append("title")
+        if author != author.strip():
+            ws_fields.append("author")
+        if pub != pub.strip():
+            ws_fields.append("publication")
+        if abbr != abbr.strip():
+            ws_fields.append("abbreviation")
+
+        if not ws_fields:
+            continue
+
+        handled_handles.add(handle)
+        s_disp = _source_display(row)
+        options = [(s_disp, handle)]
+
+        # Check if an existing source with the clean title already exists
+        clean_match = clean_sources_by_title.get(title.strip().lower())
+        if clean_match and clean_match["handle"] != handle:
+            match_disp = "%s (%s)" % (clean_match["title"], clean_match["gramps_id"])
+            options.append((_("Merge into '%s'") % match_disp, clean_match["handle"]))
+            options.append((str(_("Trim whitespace")), "trim"))
+            hint_target = clean_match["handle"]
+            hint_reason = str(_("Duplicate with clean title"))
+            hint_display = "%s\n(%s)" % (match_disp, hint_reason)
+        else:
+            options.append((str(_("Trim whitespace")), "trim"))
+            hint_target = "trim"
+            hint_reason = str(_("Leading/trailing whitespace"))
+            hint_display = "%s\n(%s)" % (str(_("Trim whitespace")), hint_reason)
+
+        if row.get("repo_count", 0) == 0:
+            options.append((str(_("Quarantine (new repository)")), "quarantine"))
+
+        repo_name = repo_name_by_handle.get(handle) or str(_("(no repository)"))
+
+        rows.append(
+            {
+                "handle": handle,
+                "title": title,
+                "gramps_id": row.get("gramps_id", ""),
+                "display": s_disp,
+                "repo_name": repo_name,
+                "citations": row.get("citations", 0),
+                "options": options,
+                "best_guess": s_disp,
+                "hint_target": hint_target,
+                "hint_reason": hint_reason,
+                "hint_display": hint_display,
+                "problem": "trim",
+                "is_keeper": False,
+                "skip": False,
+            }
+        )
+
+    # 4) Orphan / no-repository sources -> quarantine action
+    quarantine_handles = {
+        str(repo.get_handle())
+        for repo in db.iter_repositories()
+        if str(repo.get_name() or "").strip().lower() == _QUARANTINE_REPO_NAME.lower()
+    }
+    for row in stats.get("source_rows", []):
+        handle = row.get("handle")
+        if not handle or handle in handled_handles:
+            continue
+        if quarantine_handles:
+            src_obj = db.get_source_from_handle(handle)
+            if src_obj is not None and any(
+                str(ref.get_reference_handle()) in quarantine_handles
+                for ref in src_obj.get_reporef_list()
+            ):
+                continue  # already quarantined; nothing more to decide
+        reasons = []
+        # A title that is really a file name (for example a scanned family
+        # tree image) is a media object, not a source.
+        if kind_of_non_title(str(row.get("title") or "")) == "filename":
+            reasons.append(str(_("title is a file name")))
+        if row.get("citations", 0) == 0:
+            reasons.append(str(_("orphan")))
+        if row.get("repo_count", 0) == 0:
+            reasons.append(str(_("no repository")))
+        if not reasons:
+            continue
+        reason_str = ", ".join(reasons)
+        s_disp = _source_display(row)
+        options = [
+            (s_disp, handle),
+            (str(_("Quarantine (new repository)")), "quarantine"),
+        ]
+        hint_target = "quarantine"
+        hint_reason = reason_str
+        hint_display = "%s\n(%s)" % (str(_("Quarantine")), hint_reason)
+
+        repo_name = repo_name_by_handle.get(handle) or str(_("(no repository)"))
+
+        rows.append(
+            {
+                "handle": handle,
+                "title": row.get("title", ""),
+                "gramps_id": row.get("gramps_id", ""),
+                "display": s_disp,
+                "repo_name": repo_name,
+                "citations": row.get("citations", 0),
+                "options": options,
+                "best_guess": s_disp,
+                "hint_target": hint_target,
+                "hint_reason": hint_reason,
+                "hint_display": hint_display,
+                "problem": "quarantine",
+                "is_keeper": False,
+                "skip": False,
+            }
+        )
+
+    return rows
+
+
+def _resolve_merge_target(handle: str, merge_targets: dict[str, str]) -> str:
+    """Follow merge chains to find the final target, detecting cycles."""
+    visited = set()
+    curr = handle
+    while curr in merge_targets:
+        if curr in visited:
+            break
+        visited.add(curr)
+        curr = merge_targets[curr]
+    return curr
+
+
+def plan_source_fixes(
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    """Turn dialog rows into an apply plan without touching the database."""
+    plan: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {
+        "merge": [],
+        "quarantine": [],
+        "trim": [],
+    }
+    merge_targets: dict[str, str] = {}
+    quarantine_handles: set[str] = set()
+    trim_handles: set[str] = set()
+
+    for row in rows:
+        if row.get("skip"):
+            continue
+        # Support chosen_target (explicitly selected), or fallback to hint_target
+        chosen = row.get("chosen_target") or row.get("hint_target")
+        handle = row.get("handle")
+        if not chosen or not handle:
+            # Fallback for old dictionary format
+            if row.get("problem") == "merge" and "keeper_handle" in row:
+                plan["merge"].append(
+                    {
+                        "keeper_handle": row["keeper_handle"],
+                        "discard_handles": row.get("discard_handles", []),
+                    }
+                )
+            elif row.get("problem") == "quarantine" and "quarantine_handle" in row:
+                quarantine_handles.add(row["quarantine_handle"])
+            continue
+
+        if chosen == "trim":
+            trim_handles.add(handle)
+        elif chosen == "quarantine":
+            quarantine_handles.add(handle)
+        elif chosen != handle:
+            merge_targets[handle] = chosen
+
+    # Resolve transitive merges and cycles so discards point to the final surviving keeper
+    merges_by_keeper: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
+    for src_h in merge_targets:
+        final_keeper = _resolve_merge_target(src_h, merge_targets)
+        if final_keeper != src_h:
+            merges_by_keeper[final_keeper].add(src_h)
+
+    for keeper, discards in merges_by_keeper.items():
+        clean_discards = [h for h in discards if h != keeper]
+        if clean_discards:
+            plan["merge"].append(
+                {
+                    "keeper_handle": keeper,
+                    "discard_handles": clean_discards,
+                }
+            )
+
+    for handle in trim_handles:
+        if handle not in merge_targets:
+            plan["trim"].append({"source_handle": handle})
+
+    for handle in quarantine_handles:
+        if handle not in merge_targets:
+            plan["quarantine"].append(
+                {
+                    "source_handle": handle,
+                    "target_repo_name": _QUARANTINE_REPO_NAME,
+                }
+            )
+
+    return plan
+
+
+def _get_or_create_quarantine_repo(db: Any, trans: Any) -> str:
+    """Return the handle of an existing or newly created Quarantine repository."""
+    for repo in db.iter_repositories():
+        try:
+            if str(repo.get_name() or "").strip().lower() == "quarantine":
+                return str(repo.get_handle() or "")
+        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            continue
+    repo = Repository()
+    repo.set_name(_QUARANTINE_REPO_NAME)
+    db.add_repository(repo, trans)
+    return str(repo.get_handle() or "")
+
+
+def apply_source_fixes(
+    dbstate: Any, plan: dict[str, Any], trans: Any = None
+) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Apply a source-fix plan in one transaction (one Edit > Undo).
+
+    ``dbstate`` may be a DbState or a database. Returns
+    ``(merged, quarantined, trimmed)``. A quarantined source keeps any
+    repository it already has and gains the Quarantine repository, so no
+    existing repository link is lost.
+    """
+    db = getattr(dbstate, "db", dbstate)
+    if trans is None:
+        with DbTxn(_("Fix Sources"), db) as new_trans:
+            return apply_source_fixes(db, plan, new_trans)
+    engine = GWizardCitationRepairEngine()
+    merged = 0
+    quarantined = 0
+    trimmed = 0
+
+    already_merged_or_deleted: set[str] = set()
+    # Create the Quarantine repository only when a source needs it, so an
+    # unused empty repository is not left behind.
+    quarantine_handle = (
+        _get_or_create_quarantine_repo(db, trans) if plan.get("quarantine") else ""
+    )
+
+    for entry in plan.get("trim", []):
+        src_handle = entry["source_handle"]
+        if src_handle in already_merged_or_deleted:
+            continue
+        try:
+            source = db.get_source_from_handle(src_handle)
+            if source is None:
+                continue
+            title = str(source.get_title() or "")
+            author = str(source.get_author() or "")
+            pub = str(source.get_publication_info() or "")
+            abbr = str(source.get_abbreviation() or "")
+            changed = False
+            if title != title.strip():
+                source.set_title(title.strip())
+                changed = True
+            if author != author.strip():
+                source.set_author(author.strip())
+                changed = True
+            if pub != pub.strip():
+                source.set_publication_info(pub.strip())
+                changed = True
+            if abbr != abbr.strip():
+                source.set_abbreviation(abbr.strip())
+                changed = True
+            if changed:
+                db.commit_source(source, trans)
+                trimmed += 1
+        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Failed to trim source whitespace %s", src_handle)
+
+    for entry in plan.get("trim", []):
+        src_handle = entry["source_handle"]
+        if src_handle in already_merged_or_deleted:
+            continue
+        try:
+            source = db.get_source_from_handle(src_handle)
+            if source is None:
+                continue
+            title = str(source.get_title() or "")
+            author = str(source.get_author() or "")
+            pub = str(source.get_publication_info() or "")
+            abbr = str(source.get_abbreviation() or "")
+            changed = False
+            if title != title.strip():
+                source.set_title(title.strip())
+                changed = True
+            if author != author.strip():
+                source.set_author(author.strip())
+                changed = True
+            if pub != pub.strip():
+                source.set_publication_info(pub.strip())
+                changed = True
+            if abbr != abbr.strip():
+                source.set_abbreviation(abbr.strip())
+                changed = True
+            if changed:
+                with DbTxn(_("Trim source whitespace"), db) as trans:
+                    db.commit_source(source, trans)
+                trimmed += 1
+        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Failed to trim source whitespace %s", src_handle)
+
+    for entry in plan.get("merge", []):
+        keeper = entry["keeper_handle"]
+        if keeper in already_merged_or_deleted:
+            LOG.warning("Keeper %s was already merged; skipping", keeper)
+            continue
+        for discard in entry.get("discard_handles", []):
+            if discard == keeper or discard in already_merged_or_deleted:
+                continue
+            try:
+                if engine.merge_sources(db, keeper, discard, trans):
+                    merged += 1
+                    already_merged_or_deleted.add(discard)
+            except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+                LOG.exception("Failed to merge source %s into %s", discard, keeper)
+
+    for entry in plan.get("quarantine", []):
+        src_handle = entry["source_handle"]
+        if src_handle in already_merged_or_deleted:
+            continue
+        try:
+            source = db.get_source_from_handle(src_handle)
+            if source is None:
+                continue
+            if any(
+                ref.get_reference_handle() == quarantine_handle
+                for ref in source.get_reporef_list()
+            ):
+                continue
+            ref = RepoRef()
+            ref.set_reference_handle(quarantine_handle)
+            source.add_repo_reference(ref)
+            db.commit_source(source, trans)
+            quarantined += 1
+        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+            LOG.exception("Failed to quarantine source %s", src_handle)
+
+    return merged, quarantined, trimmed
+
+
+def auto_fix_sources(db: Any) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Accept every hint and apply it, exactly as the Fix Sources dialog does.
+
+    This is the single no-review implementation, shared by the dialog's
+    ``run_auto``, the per-step Auto button and Accept all hints. Returns
+    ``(merged, quarantined, trimmed)``.
+    """
+    stats = collect_db_stats(db)
+    rows = build_source_fix_rows(stats, db)
+    return apply_source_fixes(db, plan_source_fixes(rows))

+def _clean_page_field(raw_page: str, url: str, date_val: str) -> str:
+    """Strip extracted URL and access date from raw page string."""
+    cleaned = raw_page
+    if url:
+        cleaned = cleaned.replace(url, " ")
+    # Strip "accessed <date>" prefixes (and the date they carry)
+    cleaned = _ACCESS_DATE_REGEX.sub(" ", cleaned)
+    if date_val:
+        cleaned = cleaned.replace(date_val, " ")
+    # Clean whitespace and stray punctuation
+    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cleaned).strip(" \t,.;:|-()")
+    return cleaned
+
+
+def plan_unpack_conflated_citations(db: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Scan database for citations with conflated page/date/URL/note text."""
+    source_titles: dict[str, tuple[str, str, str]] = {}
+    for src in db.iter_sources():
+        s_handle = str(src.get_handle() or "")
+        title = str(src.get_title() or "")
+        gid = str(src.get_gramps_id() or "")
+        pub = str(src.get_publication_info() or "")
+        source_titles[s_handle] = (title, gid, pub)
+
+    plan: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for cit in db.iter_citations():
+        c_handle = str(cit.get_handle() or "")
+        c_gid = str(cit.get_gramps_id() or "")
+        raw_page = str(cit.get_page() or "").strip()
+        s_handle = str(cit.get_reference_handle() or "")
+        src_info = source_titles.get(s_handle, ("(no source)", "", ""))
+        src_title, src_gid, src_pub = src_info
+
+        # Extract current date
+        curr_date = ""
+        try:
+            d_obj = cit.get_date_object()
+            if d_obj and hasattr(d_obj, "is_empty") and not d_obj.is_empty():
+                from gramps.gen.datehandler import get_date
+
+                curr_date = get_date(cit) or str(d_obj)
+            elif d_obj and not hasattr(d_obj, "is_empty"):
+                s = str(d_obj)
+                if s and s != "0000-00-00":
+                    curr_date = s
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+        # Extract notes text
+        notes_list = []
+        note_entries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+        for nh in cit.get_note_list() or []:
+            try:
+                note = db.get_note_from_handle(nh)
+                if note:
+                    ntxt = str(note.get() or "").strip()
+                    if ntxt:
+                        notes_list.append(ntxt)
+                        note_entries.append((str(nh), ntxt))
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        notes_text = "\n".join(notes_list)
+        drop_note_handles: list[str] = []
+
+        # Look for conflated elements in raw_page, notes, or source pub info
+        extracted_url = _extract_url(raw_page) or _extract_url(notes_text)
+        extracted_date = ""
+        if not curr_date:
+            extracted_date = _extract_access_date(raw_page) or _extract_access_date(
+                notes_text, allow_timestamp=True
+            )
+
+        # Check if raw_page mixes URL and other text or an access date
+        is_conflated = False
+        suggested_page = ""
+        suggested_date = extracted_date
+        suggested_notes = ""
+
+        if raw_page:
+            url_in_page = _extract_url(raw_page)
+            date_in_page = _extract_access_date(raw_page)
+            if url_in_page or date_in_page:
+                cleaned = _clean_page_field(raw_page, url_in_page, date_in_page)
+                if cleaned:
+                    is_conflated = True
+                    suggested_page = cleaned
+                    if url_in_page and not any(
+                        url_in_page in text for text in notes_list
+                    ):
+                        # Only move the URL to a note if no note has it yet.
+                        suggested_notes = url_in_page
+                elif url_in_page and date_in_page and not curr_date:
+                    # Page is purely a URL, but has access date in it
+                    is_conflated = True
+                    suggested_page = url_in_page
+
+        # Check if source pub info contains citation-style volume/page fragments
+        if not raw_page and src_pub:
+            from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardcitationshared import (
+                FIELD_CITATION_PATTERNS,
+            )
+
+            if FIELD_CITATION_PATTERNS.search(src_pub):
+                is_conflated = True
+                suggested_page = src_pub
+
+        # Also flag citations where the page is empty but a note holds the URL
+        # (or a whole citation), or where only the access date is missing
+        if not is_conflated and (not raw_page or not curr_date):
+            if (not raw_page and extracted_url) or (not curr_date and extracted_date):
+                is_conflated = True
+                if not raw_page and extracted_url:
+                    suggested_page = _extract_note_entry(notes_text) or extracted_url
+                    if suggested_page == extracted_url:
+                        # The URL moves into the page, so a note that is
+                        # only that URL would become a duplicate. Drop it.
+                        drop_note_handles = [
+                            handle
+                            for handle, text in note_entries
+                            if is_bare_url_text(text) and text == extracted_url
+                        ]
+
+        if not is_conflated:
+            continue
+
+        hint_parts: list[str] = []
+        if suggested_page and suggested_page != raw_page:
+            hint_parts.append(_("Clean Volume/Page to '%s'") % suggested_page)
+        elif not raw_page and suggested_page:
+            hint_parts.append(_("Set Volume/Page to '%s'") % suggested_page)
+        if suggested_date and suggested_date != curr_date:
+            hint_parts.append(_("Extract date '%s'") % suggested_date)
+        if suggested_notes:
+            hint_parts.append(_("Move URL '%s' to notes") % suggested_notes)
+        if drop_note_handles:
+            hint_parts.append(_("Remove the note that only repeats the URL"))
+
+        hint_text = (
+            "\n".join(hint_parts) if hint_parts else _("Unpack citation elements")
+        )
+
+        # Build citation display string for column 0
+        cit_parts = []
+        if raw_page:
+            cit_parts.append(raw_page)
+        if curr_date and curr_date not in raw_page:
+            cit_parts.append(curr_date)
+        if c_gid:
+            cit_parts.append(f"({c_gid})")
+
+        citation_display = " | ".join(cit_parts) if cit_parts else f"({c_gid})"
+        source_display = f"{src_title} ({src_gid})" if src_gid else src_title
+
+        plan.append(
+            {
+                "citation_handle": c_handle,
+                "citation_gid": c_gid,
+                "source_handle": s_handle,
+                "source_title": src_title,
+                "source_gid": src_gid,
+                "raw_page": raw_page,
+                "curr_date": curr_date,
+                "source_display": source_display,
+                "citation_display": citation_display,
+                "suggested_page": suggested_page,
+                "suggested_date": suggested_date,
+                "suggested_notes": suggested_notes,
+                "drop_note_handles": drop_note_handles,
+                "hint_text": hint_text,
+            }
+        )
+
+    # Sort by source name alphabetically
+    plan.sort(key=lambda r: (r["source_title"] == "(no source)", r["source_title"]))
+    return plan
+

+    def build_rows(self, entries: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Gtk.ScrolledWindow:
+        """Build the data grid for reviewing and editing unpacked citations."""
+        grid = Gtk.Grid()

+            cit_label = Gtk.Label(label=cit_text)
+            cit_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+            cit_label.set_xalign(0.0)
+            cit_label.set_line_wrap(True)
+            cit_label.set_line_wrap_mode(Pango.WrapMode.WORD_CHAR)
+            cit_label.set_size_request(240, -1)
+            cit_label.set_max_width_chars(32)
+            grid.attach(cit_label, 1, row_index, 1, 1)

+            page_entry.set_width_chars(24)

+            date_entry.set_width_chars(14)

+            notes_entry.set_width_chars(20)
