+def cb_repo_auto(self) -> None:
+    """Apply best-guess golden merges for all non-golden repositories."""
+    from gramps.plugins.tool.gw_repomergedialog import RepoMergeDialog
+
+    dialog = RepoMergeDialog(
+        title="",
+        dbstate=self.dbstate,
+        transient_for=self.window,
+    )
+    dialog.run_auto(parent=self.window)
+    dialog.destroy()
+
+
+def cb_fix_auto(self, button: Gtk.Button, layer: str) -> None:
+    """Run the best-guess auto fix for one layer (preview-first)."""
+    if layer == "repositories":
+        self.cb_repo_auto()
+        return
+    try:
+        stats = collect_db_stats(self.dbstate.db)
+    except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+        LOG.exception("Failed to analyze database for %s", layer)
+    stats = None
+    summary = self.summarize_auto_fix(layer, stats)
+    OkDialog(
+        str(_("Auto fix preview: %s") % layer),
+        summary,
+        parent=self.window,
+    )
+
+
+def summarize_auto_fix(self, layer: str, stats: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
+    """Return a preview summary of what auto fix would do."""
+    if not stats:
+        return str(("No analysis available. Generate a report first."))
+    if layer == "repositories":
+        count = len(stats.get("sources_no_repo", []))
+        return str(("Best guess would link %d sources to repositories.") % count)
+    if layer == "sources":
+        count = len(stats.get("near_duplicates", []))
+        return str(("Best guess would merge %d duplicate groups.") % count)
+    if layer == "citations":
+        count = int(stats.get("tree_citations", 0))
+        return str(("Best guess would clean %d FamilySearch Tree citations.") % count)
+    if layer == "notes":
+        count = len(stats.get("notes_debris", []))
+        return str(("Best guess would remove %d debris notes.") % count)
+    return str(("Unknown layer: %s") % layer)
+
+
+def cb_auto_all(self) -> None:
+    """Run best-guess auto fixes across all layers in order."""
+    try:
+        stats = collect_db_stats(self.dbstate.db)
+    except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
+        LOG.exception("Failed to analyze database for auto all")
+    stats = None
+    parts = [
+        self.summarize_auto_fix(layer, stats) for layer, _t, d in get_fix_layer_specs()
+    ]
+    OkDialog(
+        str(("Auto fix preview (all layers)")),
+        "\n".join(parts),
+        parent=self.window,
+    )
+
+
+def update_view_button(self) -> None:
+    """Enable View report only when the report file exists."""
+    button = self.buttons.get("view")
+    if button is None:
+        return
+    path = self.report_path or get_report_path()
+    button.set_sensitive(report_exists(path))
+
+
+def _pump_events(self) -> None:
+    """Let pending GTK events run so the meter stays responsive."""
+    while Gtk.events_pending():
+        Gtk.main_iteration()
+
+    def cb_generate_report(self) -> None:
+        """Generates the CitationFixReport.txt using the report engine class."""
+        stages = get_report_stages()
+        meter = GWizardCitationFixProgressMeter(parent=self.window)
+        engine = GWizardCitationReport()  # Call the separate report module
+
+        try:
+            meter.show_stage(stages[0])
+            stats = engine.collect_db_stats(self.dbstate.db)
+
+            self.report_datetime = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
+            report_body = engine.format_analysis(stats)
+
+            # Simple wrapper to construct header lines
+            text = (
+                f"Citation analysis file\t\t\t{self.report_datetime}\n"
+                + ("=" * 78)
+                + "\n\n"
+                + report_body
+            )
+
+            self.report_path = get_report_path()
+            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.report_path), exist_ok=True)
+            with open(self.report_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+                handle.write(text)
+
+        except OSError as error:
+            ErrorDialog(str(_("Report Failed")), str(error), parent=self.window)
+            return
+        finally:
+            meter.close()
+
+        if self.report_path:
+            self.update_view_button()
+            self.cb_view_report()
+
+
+def cb_view_report(self) -> None:
+    """Open the generated CitationFixReport.txt in a report window."""
+    path = self.report_path or get_report_path()
+    try:
+        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+            text = handle.read()
+    except OSError:
+        OkDialog(
+            str(("No report yet")),
+            str(("Please choose Generate report first.")),
+            parent=self.window,
+        )
+        return
+    title, timestamp = parse_report_header(text)
+    if not timestamp and self.report_datetime:
+        timestamp = self.report_datetime
+    dialog = Gtk.Dialog(
+        title=str(("GWizard citation fix report")),
+        transient_for=self.window,
+        modal=True,
+        destroy_with_parent=True,
+    )
+    dialog.add_button(str(("_Close")), Gtk.ResponseType.CLOSE)
+    dialog.connect("response", lambda dlg, resp: dlg.destroy())
+    content = dialog.get_content_area()
+    content.set_border_width(12)
+    content.set_spacing(6)
+    header = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
+    title_label = Gtk.Label()
+    title_label.set_markup("%s" % title)
+    title_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.START)
+    title_label.set_hexpand(True)
+    header.pack_start(title_label, True, True, 0)
+    date_label = Gtk.Label()
+    date_label.set_markup("%s" % timestamp)
+    date_label.set_halign(Gtk.Align.END)
+    header.pack_start(date_label, False, False, 0)
+    content.add(header)
+    scrolled = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
+    scrolled.set_min_content_height(300)
+    scrolled.set_min_content_width(1080)
+    textview = Gtk.TextView()
+    textview.set_editable(False)
+    textview.set_wrap_mode(Gtk.WrapMode.WORD)
+    textview.set_vexpand(True)
+    textview.set_hexpand(True)
+    textview.get_buffer().set_text(text)
+    scrolled.add(textview)
+    content.pack_start(scrolled, True, True, 0)
+    scrolled.set_vexpand(True)
+    dialog.show_all()
+    dialog.run()
+    dialog.destroy()

+    def test_build_note_fix_rows_detection(self) -> None:
+        """Debris notes, empty notes, and whitespace notes should be detected."""
+        with DbTxn("Create notes", self.db) as trans:
+            # 1. Debris note
+            n1 = Note()
+            n1.set("Records not imported into repo: TAG_XYZ")
+            h1 = self.db.add_note(n1, trans)
+
+            # 2. Empty note
+            n2 = Note()
+            n2.set("   ")
+            h2 = self.db.add_note(n2, trans)
+
+            # 3. Whitespace note
+            n3 = Note()
+            n3.set("  Valid note with padding  ")
+            h3 = self.db.add_note(n3, trans)
+
+            # 4. Clean note (should NOT be in fix rows)
+            n4 = Note()
+            n4.set("Clean valid note.")
+            self.db.add_note(n4, trans)
+
+        rows = build_note_fix_rows(self.db)
+        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 3)
+
+        r1 = next(r for r in rows if r["note_handle"] == h1)
+        self.assertEqual(r1["suggested_action"], "Purge")
+        self.assertIn("Import debris", r1["hint_text"])
+
+        r2 = next(r for r in rows if r["note_handle"] == h2)
+        self.assertEqual(r2["suggested_action"], "Purge")
+        self.assertIn("Empty note", r2["hint_text"])
+
+        r3 = next(r for r in rows if r["note_handle"] == h3)
+        self.assertEqual(r3["suggested_action"], "Trim")
+        self.assertEqual(r3["suggested_text"], "Valid note with padding")

+    def test_classify_repo_street(self) -> None:
+        """Street repeating name should be dropped; extra detail should be moved."""
+        self.assertEqual(classify_repo_street("Ancestry", "Ancestry"), ("drop", ""))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            classify_repo_street("The National Archives", "The National Archives"),
+            ("drop", ""),
+        )
+        act, detail = classify_repo_street(
+            "State Archives", "State Archives (Microfilm Room)"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(act, "move")
+        self.assertEqual(detail, "Microfilm Room")
+        self.assertEqual(classify_repo_street("Ancestry", "123 Main St")[0], "keep")
+
+    def test_build_repo_consolidate_rows_duplicates(self) -> None:
+        """Duplicate repositories should produce rows where keeper has blank hint and duplicate points to keeper."""
+        with DbTxn("Create repos", self.db) as trans:
+            r1 = Repository()
+            r1.set_name("FamilySearch")
+            r1_handle = self.db.add_repository(r1, trans)
+
+            r2 = Repository()
+            r2.set_name("FamilySearch.org")
+            r2_handle = self.db.add_repository(r2, trans)
+
+            # Link a source to r1
+            s = Source()
+            s.set_title("Test Source")
+            ref = RepoRef()
+            ref.set_reference_handle(r1_handle)
+            s.add_repo_reference(ref)
+            self.db.add_source(s, trans)
+
+        rows = build_repo_consolidate_rows(self.db)
+        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 2)
+
+        # r1 should be keeper (is_golden name FamilySearch + 1 source)
+        keeper_row = next(r for r in rows if r["handle"] == r1_handle)
+        dup_row = next(r for r in rows if r["handle"] == r2_handle)
+
+        self.assertTrue(keeper_row["is_keeper"])
+        self.assertEqual(keeper_row["hint_target"], "")
+        self.assertEqual(keeper_row["options"][0][1], r1_handle)
+
+        self.assertFalse(dup_row["is_keeper"])
+        self.assertEqual(dup_row["hint_target"], r1_handle)
+        self.assertIn("FamilySearch", dup_row["hint_display"])
+
+    def test_build_repo_consolidate_rows_golden_match(self) -> None:
+        """Repository with golden-standard match should suggest the golden name."""
+        with DbTxn("Create repo", self.db) as trans:
+            r = Repository()
+            r.set_name("FindAGrave")  # Matches "Find a Grave"
+            r_handle = self.db.add_repository(r, trans)
+
+        rows = build_repo_consolidate_rows(self.db)
+        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 1)
+        row = rows[0]
+        self.assertEqual(row["handle"], r_handle)
+        self.assertIn("Find a Grave", row["hint_display"])
+        self.assertIn("Gold-standard match", row["hint_reason"])
+
+    def test_repo_consolidate_dialog_structure_and_accept_hints(self) -> None:
+        """Dialog initializes with Accept hints, Apply, and Close buttons; accept hints works."""
+        with DbTxn("Create repos", self.db) as trans:
+            r1 = Repository()
+            r1.set_name("Ancestry.com")
+            r1_h = self.db.add_repository(r1, trans)
+
+            r2 = Repository()
+            r2.set_name("ancestry")
+            r2_h = self.db.add_repository(r2, trans)
+
+        dlg = RepoConsolidateDialog(self.dbstate)
+
+        # Verify buttons exist
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(dlg, "accept_button"))
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(dlg, "apply_button"))
+
+        # Accept hints
+        mock_button = MagicMock()
+        with patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gw_repoconsolidatedialog.OkDialog"):
+            dlg.cb_accept_hints(mock_button)
+
+        choices = dlg.get_choices()
+        self.assertEqual(choices[r2_h], r1_h)
+
+    def test_repo_consolidate_apply_merges_and_tidies(self) -> None:
+        """Apply merges duplicate repository into keeper and cleans up address."""
+        with DbTxn("Create repos and source", self.db) as trans:
+            r1 = Repository()
+            r1.set_name("Library of Congress")
+            r1_h = self.db.add_repository(r1, trans)
+
+            r2 = Repository()
+            r2.set_name("library of congress")
+            addr = Address()
+            addr.set_street("Library of Congress")  # Redundant street
+            r2.set_address_list([addr])
+            r2_h = self.db.add_repository(r2, trans)
+
+            s = Source()
+            s.set_title("LOC Book")
+            ref = RepoRef()
+            ref.set_reference_handle(r2_h)
+            s.add_repo_reference(ref)
+            s_h = self.db.add_source(s, trans)
+
+        dlg = RepoConsolidateDialog(self.dbstate)
+        # Set r2 to merge into r1
+        for row, combo in dlg.row_combos:
+            if row["handle"] == r2_h:
+                combo._user_target = r1_h
+
+        with patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gw_repoconsolidatedialog.OkDialog"):
+            dlg.cb_apply(MagicMock())
+
+        # Verify r2 was merged into r1
+        with self.assertRaises(HandleError):
+            self.db.get_repository_from_handle(r2_h)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(self.db.get_repository_from_handle(r1_h))
+
+        # Verify source now points to r1
+        updated_s = self.db.get_source_from_handle(s_h)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(updated_s)
+        self.assertEqual(updated_s.get_reporef_list()[0].get_reference_handle(), r1_h)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+db = make_database("sqlite")
+db.load(tempfile.mkdtemp())

+def snapshot():
+    import json
+
+    out = {}
+    for name in ("source", "citation", "repository", "note"):
+        it = getattr(
+            db, "iter_%ss" % name if name != "repository" else "iter_repositories"
+        )()
+        out[name] = sorted(
+            json.dumps(o.serialize(), sort_keys=True, default=str) for o in it
+        )
+    return out
+
+
+def counts():
+    return dict(
+        src=db.get_number_of_sources(),
+        repo=db.get_number_of_repositories(),
+        cit=db.get_number_of_citations(),
+        note=db.get_number_of_notes(),
+    )
+
+
+with DbTxn("setup", db) as t:
+    # repositories mirroring the real data
+    r1 = Repository()
+    r1.set_name(
+        "Local Government and Municipal Registries (Genoa, IT / Broward County, FL)"
+    )
+    a = Address()
+    a.set_street(r1.get_name())
+    r1.add_address(a)
+    h_r1 = db.add_repository(r1, t)
+    r2 = Repository()
+    r2.set_name("The National Archives and Records Administration (NARA)")
+    a = Address()
+    a.set_street(r2.get_name())
+    r2.add_address(a)
+    h_r2 = db.add_repository(r2, t)
+
+    def mk_source(title, repo=None, author="", pub=""):
+        s = Source()
+        s.set_title(title)
+        s.set_author(author)
+        s.set_publication_info(pub)
+        if repo:
+            rr = RepoRef()
+            rr.set_reference_handle(repo)
+            s.add_repo_reference(rr)
+        return s
+
+    def mk_cit(src_handle, page="", conf=2, notes=()):
+        c = Citation()
+        c.set_reference_handle(src_handle)
+        c.set_page(page)
+        c.set_confidence_level(conf)
+        for n in notes:
+            nn = Note()
+            nn.set(n)
+            nn.set_type(NoteType.CITATION)
+            c.add_note(db.add_note(nn, t))
+        return db.add_citation(c, t)
+
+    # duplicate sources with conflicting text
+    s1 = mk_source(
+        "Pennsylvania, U.S., Marriages, 1852-1968",
+        h_r2,
+        author="Ancestry.com",
+        pub="Provo, UT",
+    )
+    s2 = mk_source(
+        "Pennsylvania, Marriages, 1852-1968",
+        h_r2,
+        author="FamilySearch",
+        pub="Salt Lake City",
+    )
+    hs1 = db.add_source(s1, t)
+    hs2 = db.add_source(s2, t)
+    mk_cit(hs1, "Vol 1")
+    mk_cit(hs2, "Vol 2")
+    # tree source with conflated pages
+    odd = mk_source(
+        "Newspapers.com Obituary Index, 1800s-current (Repository: Newspapers.com, Source: Obituary Index)"
+    )
+    db.add_source(odd, t)
+    tree = mk_source("FamilySearch Family Tree", h_r1)
+    htree = db.add_source(tree, t)
+    for i in range(3):
+        mk_cit(
+            htree,
+            "(accessed 12 Jul 2026), entry for Person%d, person ID ABC-%d." % (i, i),
+            conf=3,
+        )
+    # citation with empty page and bare URL note (should copy then drop the note)
+    ssrc = mk_source("U.S., Find A Grave Index", h_r2)
+    hss = db.add_source(ssrc, t)
+    c_url = mk_cit(
+        hss, "", 2, notes=["https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XYZ?view=index"]
+    )
+    # citation whose page holds URL + text while a note already holds the URL
+    c_dup = mk_cit(
+        hss,

+        2,

+    )

+    jpg = mk_source("LoisWhite - PittalugaFAMILY TREE.jpg", h_r2)
+    hjpg = db.add_source(jpg, t)
+    mk_cit(hjpg, "")
+    # notes
+    for txt in [
+        "Records not imported into REPO (repository) Gramps ID R00001:ADDR element ignored 'x'",
+        "   ",
+        "  padded  ",
+    ]:
+        n = Note()
+        n.set(txt)
+        db.add_note(n, t)
+
+print("start", counts())
+steps = []
+for layer in fix.AUTO_STEP_LAYERS:
+    before = counts()
+    snap = snapshot()
+    undo_depth_before = (
+        db.undodb.undoq.__len__() if hasattr(db.undodb, "undoq") else None
+    )
+    msg = fix.run_auto_layer(layer, db)
+    after = counts()
+    print("%-26s %s" % (layer, msg), "|", after)
+    # one undo reverses exactly this step
+    changed = after != before
+    ok = db.undo()
+    reverted = snapshot() == snap
+    db.redo()
+    print(
+        "   undo ok=%s content-identical-after-ONE-undo=%s (step changed db: %s)"
+        % (ok, reverted, changed)
+    )
+
+print("\n--- final state")
+for s in db.iter_sources():
+    print(
+        "SRC",
+        s.get_gramps_id(),
+        repr(s.get_title()),
+        [db.get_repository_from_handle(r.ref).get_name() for r in s.get_reporef_list()],
+        "notes:",
+        [note_text(db.get_note_from_handle(n)) for n in s.get_note_list()],
+    )
+for r in db.iter_repositories():
+    print(
+        "REPO",
+        repr(r.get_name()),
+        [a.get_street() for a in r.get_address_list()],
+        [u.get_path() for u in r.get_url_list()],
+        [note_text(db.get_note_from_handle(n)) for n in r.get_note_list()],
+    )
+for c in db.iter_citations():
+    print(
+        "CIT",
+        repr(c.get_page()),
+        c.get_confidence_level(),
+        [(str(a.get_type()), a.get_value()) for a in c.get_attribute_list()],
+        [note_text(db.get_note_from_handle(n))[:50] for n in c.get_note_list()],
+        c.get_date_object(),
+    )
+print("NOTES", [note_text(n)[:40] for n in db.iter_notes()])
+print("REVIEW:", fix.find_items_needing_review(db))
+
+print("\n=== second full pass (should be idempotent)")
+snap1 = snapshot()
+for layer in fix.AUTO_STEP_LAYERS:
+    print("%-26s %s" % (layer, fix.run_auto_layer(layer, db)))
+print("db unchanged by second pass:", snapshot() == snap1)
+
+print("\n=== repo chain A->B->C and cycle safety")
+from gramps.plugins.tool.gw_repoconsolidatedialog import apply_repo_consolidations
+
+with DbTxn("mk", db) as t:
+    hs = []
+    for nm in ("Chain A", "Chain B", "Chain C"):
+        r = Repository()
+        r.set_name(nm)
+        hs.append(db.add_repository(r, t))
+res = apply_repo_consolidations(db, [(hs[0], hs[1]), (hs[1], hs[2])])
+
+
+def exists(h):
+    try:
+        db.get_repository_from_handle(h)
+        return True
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+
+
+print(res, [exists(h) for h in hs])
+with DbTxn("mk2", db) as t:
+    r = Repository()
+    r.set_name("Cyc X")
+    x = db.add_repository(r, t)
+    r = Repository()
+    r.set_name("Cyc Y")
+    y = db.add_repository(r, t)
+res = apply_repo_consolidations(db, [(x, y), (y, x)])
+print("cycle:", res["merged"], res["errors"], exists(x), exists(y))
+
+print("\n=== third pass (parser input converges after 2 passes)")
+snap2 = snapshot()
+msgs = [fix.run_auto_layer(l, db) for l in fix.AUTO_STEP_LAYERS]
+print(msgs)
+print("db unchanged by third pass:", snapshot() == snap2)

+class SourceFixDialogTest(unittest.TestCase):

+    def test_build_source_fix_rows_near_duplicates(self) -> None:
+        """Verify near duplicates produce one row per member with default=self and keeper hinted."""
+        stats = {
+            "near_duplicates": [
+                [
+                    {
+                        "handle": "s1",
+                        "title": "1900 US Census",
+                        "gramps_id": "S0001",
+                        "citations": 10,
+                        "repo_count": 1,
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "handle": "s2",
+                        "title": "1900 US Census",
+                        "gramps_id": "S0002",
+                        "citations": 1,
+                        "repo_count": 0,
+                    },
+                ]
+            ],
+            "source_rows": [],
+        }
+
+        rows = build_source_fix_rows(stats)
+        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 2)
+
+        # Keeper row (s1)
+        r1 = rows[0]
+        self.assertEqual(r1["handle"], "s1")
+        self.assertTrue(r1["is_keeper"])
+        self.assertEqual(r1["options"][0][1], "s1")  # Default choice is s1
+        self.assertEqual(r1["hint_target"], "")  # No hint
+        self.assertEqual(r1["hint_display"], "")  # Blank hint!
+
+        # Duplicate row (s2)
+        r2 = rows[1]
+        self.assertEqual(r2["handle"], "s2")
+        self.assertFalse(r2["is_keeper"])
+        self.assertEqual(r2["options"][0][1], "s2")  # Default choice is s2
+        self.assertEqual(r2["hint_target"], "s1")  # Hinted to keeper s1
+        self.assertIn("S0001", r2["hint_display"])
+        self.assertIn("Keeper", r2["hint_reason"])
+
+    def test_build_source_fix_rows_quarantine(self) -> None:

+    def test_plan_source_fixes_default_vs_accepted(self) -> None:
+        """Verify plan has no merges when choices unchanged, but plans fixes when hints accepted."""
+        stats = {
+            "near_duplicates": [
+                [
+                    {
+                        "handle": "s1",
+                        "title": "Census",
+                        "gramps_id": "S0001",
+                        "citations": 5,

+                    },

+                        "handle": "s2",
+                        "title": "Census",
+                        "gramps_id": "S0002",
+                        "citations": 0,
+                        "repo_count": 0,
+                    },
+                ]
+            ],
+            "source_rows": [],
+        }
+        rows = build_source_fix_rows(stats)
+
+        # Default choices: every row's chosen target is its own handle
+        for r in rows:
+            r["chosen_target"] = r["handle"]
+        plan_default = plan_source_fixes(rows)
+        self.assertEqual(len(plan_default["merge"]), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(len(plan_default["quarantine"]), 0)
+
+        # Accepted hints: row with hint gets hint_target
+        for r in rows:
+            r["chosen_target"] = r["hint_target"] or r["handle"]
+        plan_accepted = plan_source_fixes(rows)
+        self.assertEqual(len(plan_accepted["merge"]), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(plan_accepted["merge"][0]["keeper_handle"], "s1")
+        self.assertEqual(plan_accepted["merge"][0]["discard_handles"], ["s2"])

+    def test_apply_source_fixes(self) -> None:
+        """Verify apply_source_fixes merges sources and moves citations."""
+        with DbTxn("Create test sources", self.db) as trans:
+            repo = Repository()
+            repo.set_name("National Archives")
+            r_h = self.db.add_repository(repo, trans)
+
+            s1 = Source()
+            s1.set_title("Census 1900")
+            rref = RepoRef()
+            rref.set_reference_handle(r_h)
+            s1.add_repo_reference(rref)
+            s1_h = self.db.add_source(s1, trans)
+
+            s2 = Source()
+            s2.set_title("Census 1900")
+            s2_h = self.db.add_source(s2, trans)
+
+            s3 = Source()
+            s3.set_title("Orphan Document")
+            s3_h = self.db.add_source(s3, trans)
+
+            cit = Citation()
+            cit.set_reference_handle(s2_h)
+            c_h = self.db.add_citation(cit, trans)
+
+        class DummyDbState:
+            def __init__(self, db: DbWriteBase) -> None:
+                self.db = db
+
+        plan = {
+            "merge": [{"keeper_handle": s1_h, "discard_handles": [s2_h]}],
+            "quarantine": [{"source_handle": s3_h, "target_repo_name": "Quarantine"}],
+        }
+
+        merged, quarantined, trimmed = apply_source_fixes(DummyDbState(self.db), plan)
+        self.assertEqual(merged, 1)
+        self.assertEqual(quarantined, 1)
+        self.assertEqual(trimmed, 0)
+
+        # Verify s2 was merged into s1 (citation moved to s1, s2 deleted)
+        with self.assertRaises(HandleError):
+            self.db.get_source_from_handle(s2_h)
+        updated_cit = self.db.get_citation_from_handle(c_h)
+        self.assertEqual(updated_cit.get_reference_handle(), s1_h)
+
+        # Verify s3 was assigned to Quarantine repository
+        updated_s3 = self.db.get_source_from_handle(s3_h)
+        self.assertTrue(len(updated_s3.get_reporef_list()) >= 1)
+        q_repo = self.db.get_repository_from_handle(
+            updated_s3.get_reporef_list()[0].get_reference_handle()
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(q_repo.get_name(), "Quarantine")
+

+        with DbTxn("Create sources for chain", self.db) as trans:

+            s2.set_title("Intermediate Source")

+
+            s3 = Source()
+            s3.set_title("Leaf Source")
+            s3_h = self.db.add_source(s3, trans)
+
+        # Plan with transitive chain s3 -> s2, s2 -> s1, plus an already-nonexistent handle
+        rows = [
+            {"handle": s1_h, "chosen_target": s1_h},
+            {"handle": s2_h, "chosen_target": s1_h},
+            {"handle": s3_h, "chosen_target": s2_h},
+            {"handle": "nonexistent_h", "chosen_target": s1_h},
+        ]
+        plan = plan_source_fixes(rows)
+
+        class DummyDbState:
+            def __init__(self, db: DbWriteBase) -> None:
+                self.db = db
+
+        # Should merge s2 and s3 into s1, skip nonexistent_h gracefully without HandleError
+        merged, quarantined, trimmed = apply_source_fixes(DummyDbState(self.db), plan)
+        self.assertEqual(merged, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(quarantined, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(trimmed, 0)
+
+        # s1 should still exist, s2 and s3 should be gone
+        self.assertIsNotNone(self.db.get_source_from_handle(s1_h))
+        with self.assertRaises(HandleError):
+            self.db.get_source_from_handle(s2_h)
+        with self.assertRaises(HandleError):
+            self.db.get_source_from_handle(s3_h)

+"""Test stubs: lets the GWizard modules import without GTK. Set GWIZARD_PLUGIN_DIR to the folder holding the plugin .py files (default: parent of tests/)."""
+
+import sys, types
+
+
+class _Meta(type):
+    def __getattr__(cls, name):
+        if name.startswith("__"):
+            raise AttributeError(name)
+        return _mk(name)
+
+
+def _mk(name):
+    return _Meta(
+        name,
+        (object,),
+        {
+            "__init__": lambda self, *a, **k: None,
+            "__getattr__": lambda self, n: (
+                (_ for _ in ()).throw(AttributeError(n))
+                if n.startswith("__")
+                else _mk(n)()
+            ),
+            "__call__": lambda self, *a, **k: _mk("r")(),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def _module(name):
+    m = types.ModuleType(name)
+    m.__getattr__ = lambda n: _mk(n)
+    sys.modules[name] = m
+    return m
+
+
+import gi
+import gi.repository as _repo
+
+for _n in ("Gtk", "Gdk", "Pango"):
+    _m = _module("gi.repository." + _n)
+    setattr(_repo, _n, _m)
+for n in (
+    "gramps.gui.dialog",
+    "gramps.gui.managedwindow",
+    "gramps.gui.plug",
+    "gramps.gui.utils",
+):
+    _module(n)
+
+import gramps.plugins.tool as tool_pkg
+import os
+
+tool_pkg.__path__.insert(
+    0,
+    os.environ.get("GWIZARD_PLUGIN_DIR", os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")),
+)

+class GWizardCommonTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Test suite for GWizard common UI widgets and path utilities."""
+
+    def test_selectable_label_defaults(self) -> None:
+        """SelectableLabel initializes with selectable=True, left alignment, and wrapping."""
+        lbl = SelectableLabel("Test copyable text")
+        self.assertTrue(lbl.selectable)
+        self.assertFalse(lbl.can_focus)
+        self.assertTrue(lbl.line_wrap)
+        self.assertEqual(lbl.text, "Test copyable text")
+
+    def test_table_label(self) -> None:
+        """TableLabel inherits from SelectableLabel and sets constraints."""
+        tbl_lbl = TableLabel(
+            "Cell text", width_chars=30, width_request=240, markup=False
+        )
+        self.assertIsInstance(tbl_lbl, SelectableLabel)
+        self.assertTrue(tbl_lbl.selectable)
+        self.assertEqual(tbl_lbl.text, "Cell text")
+        self.assertEqual(tbl_lbl.max_width_chars, 30)
+        self.assertEqual(tbl_lbl.size_request, (240, -1))
+
+    def test_header_label(self) -> None:
+        """HeaderLabel inherits from SelectableLabel and displays bold markup."""
+        hdr = HeaderLabel("Column Title")
+        self.assertIsInstance(hdr, SelectableLabel)
+        self.assertTrue(hdr.selectable)
+        self.assertEqual(hdr.markup, "<b>Column Title</b>")
+
+    def test_create_table_grid(self) -> None:
+        """create_table_grid sets spacing and expansion defaults."""
+        grid = create_table_grid(col_spacing=8, row_spacing=4)
+        self.assertEqual(grid.col_spacing, 8)
+        self.assertEqual(grid.row_spacing, 4)
+        self.assertTrue(grid.hexpand)
+        self.assertTrue(grid.vexpand)
+
+    def test_clean_path(self) -> None:
+        """clean_path strips whitespace and matching quotes, retaining legitimate apostrophes."""
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path(None), "")
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path(""), "")
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path("   "), "")
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path('  "C:/path/file.jpg"  '), "C:/path/file.jpg")
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path("  'C:/path/file.jpg'  "), "C:/path/file.jpg")
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path('""nested""'), "nested")
+        # Unmatched double quotes stripped
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path('"file.jpg'), "file.jpg")
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path('file.jpg"'), "file.jpg")
+        # Legitimate trailing apostrophe retained
+        self.assertEqual(clean_path("Grandma's"), "Grandma's")
+
+    def test_is_absolute_path(self) -> None:
+        """is_absolute_path identifies drive letters, posix roots, and rooted driveless paths."""
+        self.assertFalse(is_absolute_path(None))
+        self.assertFalse(is_absolute_path(""))
+        self.assertFalse(is_absolute_path("relative/photo.jpg"))
+        self.assertTrue(is_absolute_path(r"C:\photos\photo.jpg"))
+        self.assertTrue(is_absolute_path("/home/user/photo.jpg"))
+        self.assertTrue(is_absolute_path(r"\Users\name\photo.jpg"))
+
+    def test_path_key(self) -> None:
+        """path_key returns normalized, case-folded path for consistent mapping."""
+        key1 = path_key(r"C:\Photos\Family\Pic.JPG")
+        key2 = path_key(' "c:/photos/family/pic.jpg" ')
+        self.assertEqual(key1, key2)
+
+    def test_to_db_path(self) -> None:
+        """to_db_path relativizes paths inside base_dir with forward slashes and preserves outside."""
+        base = os.path.abspath(r"C:\Tree\Media")
+        inside = os.path.join(base, "Sub", "Photo.jpg")
+        outside = os.path.abspath(r"C:\Other\Photo.jpg")
+
+        self.assertEqual(to_db_path(inside, base), "Sub/Photo.jpg")
+        self.assertEqual(to_db_path(outside, base), outside)
+        self.assertEqual(to_db_path("", base), "")
+        self.assertEqual(to_db_path(inside, ""), inside)
+
+    def test_unique_destination(self) -> None:
+        """unique_destination appends numerical suffixes to avoid collisions on disk and in batch."""
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
+            f1 = os.path.join(temp_dir, "pic.jpg")
+            with open(f1, "w") as f:
+                f.write("content")
+
+            claimed: set[str] = set()
+            # Same file as src is allowed unchanged
+            cand1 = unique_destination(f1, claimed, src=f1)
+            self.assertEqual(cand1, f1)
+
+            # Different src colliding with existing file gets _2
+            claimed.clear()
+            cand2 = unique_destination(f1, claimed, src=None)
+            self.assertEqual(cand2, os.path.join(temp_dir, "pic_2.jpg"))
+            self.assertIn(path_key(cand2), claimed)
+
+            # Next request gets _3
+            cand3 = unique_destination(f1, claimed, src=None)
+            self.assertEqual(cand3, os.path.join(temp_dir, "pic_3.jpg"))
+
+    def test_relocate_file_move_and_copy(self) -> None:
+        """relocate_file safely moves or copies files and creates destination directories."""
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
+            src = os.path.join(temp_dir, "source.jpg")
+            with open(src, "w") as f:
+                f.write("test content")
+
+            # Copy to new subfolder
+            copy_dest = os.path.join(temp_dir, "sub", "copied.jpg")
+            ok, err = relocate_file(src, copy_dest, copy=True)
+            self.assertTrue(ok)
+            self.assertEqual(err, "")
+            self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(src))
+            self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(copy_dest))
+
+            # Move to another subfolder
+            move_dest = os.path.join(temp_dir, "other", "moved.jpg")
+            ok, err = relocate_file(src, move_dest, copy=False)
+            self.assertTrue(ok)
+            self.assertEqual(err, "")
+            self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(src))
+            self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(move_dest))
+
+    def test_relocate_file_overwrite_protection(self) -> None:
+        """relocate_file rejects overwriting an existing destination with different content."""
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
+            f1 = os.path.join(temp_dir, "file1.jpg")
+            f2 = os.path.join(temp_dir, "file2.jpg")
+            with open(f1, "w") as f:
+                f.write("content 1")
+            with open(f2, "w") as f:
+                f.write("content 2")
+
+            ok, err = relocate_file(f1, f2, copy=False)
+            self.assertFalse(ok)
+            self.assertIn("already exists", err)
+
+    def test_build_basename_index(self) -> None:
+        """build_basename_index indexes filenames recursively, ignoring hidden files."""
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
+            sub = os.path.join(temp_dir, "nested")
+            os.makedirs(sub)
+            with open(os.path.join(temp_dir, "Photo.JPG"), "w") as f:
+                f.write("1")
+            with open(os.path.join(sub, "Doc.PDF"), "w") as f:
+                f.write("2")
+            with open(os.path.join(temp_dir, ".hidden"), "w") as f:
+                f.write("3")
+
+            idx = build_basename_index(temp_dir)
+            self.assertIn("photo.jpg", idx)
+            self.assertIn("doc.pdf", idx)
+            self.assertNotIn(".hidden", idx)
+            self.assertEqual(len(idx["photo.jpg"]), 1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+        self.commits += 1

+    def test_deterministic_ref_id_backlink_order(self) -> None:
+        """resolve_media_reference_context resolves the described person regardless of backlink order."""
+        refs: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
+        citations = [("Citation", "c1"), ("Citation", "c2"), ("Citation", "c3")]
+        for perm in itertools.permutations(citations):
+            back = dict(self.base_back)
+            back["m0"] = list(perm)
+            med = _Media(
+                "m0",
+                "O00000",
+                "Fuller, Harry Jay - 1910Census",
+                "/x/Fuller, Harry Jay - 1910Census.jpg",
+            )
+            db = _MockDB(
+                "/b",
+                [med],
+                back,
+                P=self.p_map,
+                E=self.e_map,
+                C=self.c_map,
+            )
+            ctx = m.resolve_media_reference_context(db, med)
+            refs.add((ctx["ref_id"], ctx["surname"], ctx["given"]))
+
+        self.assertEqual(refs, {("I00450", "Fuller", "Harry Jay")})

+    def test_stable_ref_id_for_undescribed_media(self) -> None:

+    def test_build_accept_all_plan_dry_run(self) -> None:

+        self.assertTrue(halted_plan["halted"])
+        self.assertEqual(halted_plan["moves"], [])

+    def test_content_hash_token_uniqueness(self) -> None:
+        """The {hash} token generates distinct filenames for different content and identical for same."""
+        tmp = pathlib.Path(self.temp_dir)
+        (tmp / "a.jpg").write_text("CONTENT_AAA")
+        (tmp / "b.jpg").write_text("CONTENT_BBB")
+
+        ma = _Media("ma", "O1", "Smith, J - 1900Census", str(tmp / "a.jpg"))
+        mb = _Media("mb", "O2", "Smith, J - 1900Census", str(tmp / "b.jpg"))
+        db = _MockDB(str(tmp), [ma, mb], {})
+
+        template = "{surname}_{given}-{doc_type}-{year}-{hash}.{ext}"
+        name_a = m.sanitize_standard_filename(
+            ma.path, db=db, media=ma, template=template
+        )
+        name_b = m.sanitize_standard_filename(
+            mb.path, db=db, media=mb, template=template
+        )
+
+        self.assertNotEqual(name_a, name_b)
+        self.assertTrue(name_a.endswith(".jpg"))
+        self.assertTrue(name_b.endswith(".jpg"))
+
+        # Re-evaluating the same file produces identical name
+        self.assertEqual(
+            name_a,
+            m.sanitize_standard_filename(ma.path, db=db, media=ma, template=template),
+        )

+    def test_reference_context_caching(self) -> None:
+        """resolve_media_reference_context with cache parameter avoids repeated computation."""
+        med = _Media("m0", "O00000", "test photo", "/path/photo.jpg")
+        db = _MockDB("/b", [med], {})
+
+        calls: list[int] = []
+        orig = m._resolve_media_reference_context_uncached
+
+        def mock_uncached(d: Any, x: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
+            calls.append(1)
+            return orig(d, x)
+
+        with unittest.mock.patch.object(
+            m, "_resolve_media_reference_context_uncached", side_effect=mock_uncached
+        ):
+            cache: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
+            for _ in range(3):
+                m.resolve_media_reference_context(db, med, cache)
+            self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
+

+    unittest.main()

+class _FakeRadioButton:
+    def __init__(self, group: Any = None, label: str = "") -> None:
+        self._active = False
+        self.group = group if group is not None else self
+        self._peers = [self]
+        if group is not None and hasattr(group, "_peers"):
+            group._peers.append(self)
+            self._peers = group._peers
+        self.label = label
+        self._callbacks: list[Any] = []
+
+    @classmethod
+    def new_with_label_from_widget(
+        cls, group: Any = None, label: str = ""
+    ) -> _FakeRadioButton:
+        btn = cls(group, label)
+        if group is None:
+            btn._active = True
+        return btn
+
+    def set_active(self, val: bool) -> None:
+        self._active = val
+        if val:
+            for peer in self._peers:
+                if peer is not self:
+                    peer._active = False
+        for cb in self._callbacks:
+            try:
+                cb(self)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+    def get_active(self) -> bool:
+        return self._active
+
+    def connect(self, signal: str, callback: Any, *args: Any) -> None:
+        if signal == "toggled":
+            self._callbacks.append(callback)

+    def test_sanitize_standard_filename(self) -> None:
+        """Filenames should be sanitized with lowercase extensions and clean names."""
+        res1 = sanitize_standard_filename("Photo of John Smith (1880).JPEG")
+        self.assertEqual(res1, "Photo_of_John_Smith_1880.jpeg")
+
+        res2 = sanitize_standard_filename(
+            os.path.join("documents", "My Census Record#1.PNG")
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(res2, os.path.join("documents", "My_Census_Record_1.png"))
+
+        # Separator with hyphen should not turn into '_-_'
+        res3 = sanitize_standard_filename("Smith - John - 1920.jpg")
+        self.assertEqual(res3, "Smith-John-1920.jpg")
+
+        res4 = sanitize_standard_filename("1920 Census - Smith, John.jpg")
+        self.assertEqual(res4, "1920_Census-Smith_John.jpg")
+
+        res5 = sanitize_standard_filename("Photo_-_John.JPG")
+        self.assertEqual(res5, "Photo-John.jpg")

+    def test_resolve_media_reference_context_person(self) -> None:
+        """Resolve context for media referenced by a Person."""
+        with DbTxn("Create person media", self.db) as trans:
+            m = Media()
+            m.set_description("Headstone")
+            m.set_path("photos/raw_scan.JPG")
+            m_handle = self.db.add_media(m, trans)
+
+            p = Person()
+            n = Name()
+            s = Surname()
+            s.set_surname("Doe")
+            n.add_surname(s)
+            n.set_first_name("Mary")
+            p.set_primary_name(n)
+
+            d = Date()
+            d.set_year(1985)
+            e = Event()
+            e.set_type(EventType.DEATH)
+            e.set_date_object(d)
+            e_h = db_add_e = self.db.add_event(e, trans)
+            eref = EventRef()
+            eref.set_reference_handle(e_h)
+            p.add_event_ref(eref)
+
+            mref = MediaRef()
+            mref.set_reference_handle(m_handle)
+            p.add_media_reference(mref)
+            p_handle = self.db.add_person(p, trans)
+
+        media = self.db.get_media_from_handle(m_handle)
+        ctx = resolve_media_reference_context(self.db, media)
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["surname"], "Doe")
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["given"], "Mary")

+
+        std_path = sanitize_standard_filename(media.get_path(), db=self.db, media=media)

+    def test_format_standard_filename_presets(self) -> None:
+        """All filename presets produce platform-safe filenames without invalid characters."""
+        context = {
+            "ref_id": "I0042",
+            "surname": "Smith",
+            "given": "John",
+            "doc_type": "Birth Certificate",
+            "year": "1920",
+            "id": "O0001",
+            "orig": "scan#1 (original)",
+            "ext": "JPEG",
+        }

+            self.assertNotIn("_-_", formatted)

+            self.assertNotIn("__", formatted)
+            self.assertLessEqual(len(formatted), 90)

+    def test_citation_backlink_deep_traversal(self) -> None:
+        """Citation backlinks traverse through Event to Person to extract surname and event type."""
+        with DbTxn("Create citation hierarchy", self.db) as trans:
+            s = Source()
+            s.set_title("FamilySearch")
+            s_h = self.db.add_source(s, trans)
+
+            c = Citation()
+            c.set_page("p. 42")
+            c.set_reference_handle(s_h)
+            c_h = self.db.add_citation(c, trans)
+
+            m = Media()
+            m.set_path("C:/gramps_dev/Fuller, Harry Jay - 1910Census.jpg")
+            m.set_description("1910 Census scan")
+            m_h = self.db.add_media(m, trans)
+
+            mref = MediaRef()
+            mref.set_reference_handle(m_h)
+            c.add_media_reference(mref)
+            self.db.commit_citation(c, trans)
+
+            e = Event()
+            e.set_type(EventType.CENSUS)
+            e.set_description("1910 Census")
+            d = Date()
+            d.set_year(1910)
+            e.set_date_object(d)
+            e.add_citation(c_h)
+            e_h = self.db.add_event(e, trans)
+
+            p = Person()
+            n = Name()
+            sur = Surname()
+            sur.set_surname("Fuller")
+            n.add_surname(sur)
+            n.set_first_name("Harry Jay")
+            p.set_primary_name(n)
+            eref = EventRef()
+            eref.set_reference_handle(e_h)
+            p.add_event_ref(eref)
+            p_h = self.db.add_person(p, trans)
+
+        media = self.db.get_media_from_handle(m_h)
+        ctx = resolve_media_reference_context(self.db, media)
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["surname"], "Fuller")
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["given"], "Harry Jay")
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["doc_type"], "Census_scan")
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["year"], "1910")
+        self.assertIn("Citation:", ctx["assoc"])
+        self.assertIn("Event: Census 1910", ctx["assoc"])
+        self.assertIn("Fuller, Harry Jay", ctx["assoc"])
+
+        std = sanitize_standard_filename(media.get_path(), db=self.db, media=media)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            std,
+            os.path.join(
+                "C:/gramps_dev",
+                f"{ctx['ref_id']}_Fuller_Harry_Jay-Census_scan-1910.jpg",
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def test_deduplicate_name_and_document_year(self) -> None:
+        """Redundant names in descriptions are stripped and document year takes precedence over birth year."""
+        with DbTxn("Create Duvault media", self.db) as trans:
+            m = Media()
+            m.set_description("Duvault, Nettie - 1900Census")
+            m.set_path("Media/Duvault, Nettie - 1900Census.jpg")
+            m_h = self.db.add_media(m, trans)
+
+            p = Person()
+            n = Name()
+            s = Surname()
+            s.set_surname("Devault")
+            n.add_surname(s)
+            n.set_first_name("Nettie")
+            p.set_primary_name(n)
+
+            # Person's birth event is 1885
+            d = Date()
+            d.set_year(1885)
+            e = Event()
+            e.set_type(EventType.BIRTH)
+            e.set_date_object(d)
+            e_h = self.db.add_event(e, trans)
+            eref = EventRef()
+            eref.set_reference_handle(e_h)
+            p.add_event_ref(eref)
+
+            mref = MediaRef()
+            mref.set_reference_handle(m_h)
+            p.add_media_reference(mref)
+            p_h = self.db.add_person(p, trans)
+
+        media = self.db.get_media_from_handle(m_h)
+        ctx = resolve_media_reference_context(self.db, media)
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["surname"], "Devault")
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["given"], "Nettie")
+        # Document year 1900 from description overrides birth year 1885
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["year"], "1900")
+        self.assertEqual(ctx["doc_type"], "Census")
+
+        std = sanitize_standard_filename(media.get_path(), db=self.db, media=media)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            std,
+            os.path.join(
+                "Media",
+                f"{ctx['ref_id']}_Devault_Nettie-Census-1900.jpg",
+            ),
+        )

+    def test_get_media_base_path(self) -> None:
+        """get_media_base_path retrieves configured database media path or falls back to USER_HOME."""
+        # Unconfigured / None fallback to USER_HOME
+        self.db.set_mediapath(None)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            get_media_base_path(self.db), os.path.normpath(os.path.abspath(USER_HOME))
+        )
+
+        # Empty string fallback to USER_HOME
+        self.db.set_mediapath("   ")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            get_media_base_path(self.db), os.path.normpath(os.path.abspath(USER_HOME))
+        )
+
+        # None db fallback to USER_HOME
+        self.assertEqual(
+            get_media_base_path(None), os.path.normpath(os.path.abspath(USER_HOME))
+        )
+
+        # Configured path is returned normalized
+        custom_path = os.path.join(USER_HOME, "CustomFamilyMedia")
+        self.db.set_mediapath(custom_path)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            get_media_base_path(self.db), os.path.normpath(os.path.abspath(custom_path))
+        )

+        expected_orig = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(custom_path, "photo.jpg"))

+            os.path.normpath(dlg.rows[0]["suggested_path"]),
+            expected_orig,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            os.path.normpath(dlg.rows[0]["hint_text"]),
+            expected_orig,
+        )
+
+        # Accept hints copies to Consolidated Path textbox
+        with patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.OkDialog"):
+            dlg.cb_accept_hints(MagicMock())
+        self.assertEqual(
+            os.path.normpath(dlg.row_targets[0]["path_entry"].get_text()),
+            expected_orig,
+        )

+    def test_find_and_consolidate_quotes_and_spaces(self) -> None:
+        """Find Media and Consolidate operations handle paths enclosed in quotes and containing spaces."""
+        temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            # File with spaces on disk
+            real_file = os.path.join(temp_dir, "My Photo File 1920.jpg")
+            with open(real_file, "w") as f:
+                f.write("content")
+
+            with DbTxn("Create media with missing path", self.db) as trans:
+                m = Media()
+                m.set_description("Photo with spaces")
+                m.set_path("missing/old photo.jpg")
+                m_h = self.db.add_media(m, trans)
+
+            dlg_find = FindMissingMediaDialog(dbstate=self.dbstate)
+            self.assertEqual(len(dlg_find.rows), 1)
+
+            # User enters/pastes path enclosed in quotes (e.g. copied from Windows Explorer)
+            quoted_input = f'"{real_file}"'
+            mock_entry = MagicMock()
+            mock_entry.get_text.return_value = quoted_input
+            dlg_find.row_targets = [
+                {"entry": dlg_find.rows[0], "path_entry": mock_entry}
+            ]
+
+            with patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.OkDialog"):
+                dlg_find.cb_apply(MagicMock())
+
+            # Path stored in database must be stripped of quotes
+            updated = self.db.get_media_from_handle(m_h)
+            self.assertEqual(updated.get_path(), real_file)
+            self.assertFalse(updated.get_path().startswith('"'))
+
+            # Report should now find the file on disk instead of reporting it missing
+            report = generate_media_fix_report(self.db)
+            self.assertIn("Files found on disk:       1", report)
+            self.assertIn("Files missing on disk:     0", report)
+
+            # Consolidate media location with spaces and quotes in base path
+            base_dir = os.path.join(temp_dir, "Consolidated Media Base")
+            os.makedirs(base_dir, exist_ok=True)
+            self.db.set_mediapath(f'"{base_dir}"')
+
+            dlg_cons = ConsolidateMediaLocationDialog(dbstate=self.dbstate)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                dlg_cons.base_dir, os.path.normpath(os.path.abspath(base_dir))
+            )
+
+            # User accepts hints or inputs path
+            hint_sug = dlg_cons.rows[0]["suggested_path"]
+            self.assertIn("Photo_with_spaces.jpg", hint_sug)
+            self.assertIn("Consolidated Media Base", hint_sug)
+
+            mock_cons_entry = MagicMock()
+            mock_cons_entry.get_text.return_value = f'"{hint_sug}"'
+            dlg_cons.row_targets[0]["path_entry"] = mock_cons_entry
+
+            with patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.OkDialog"):
+                dlg_cons.cb_apply(MagicMock())
+
+            # File should be moved to destination and updated in DB without quotes
+            updated_cons = self.db.get_media_from_handle(m_h)
+            from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizard_common import to_db_path
+
+            self.assertEqual(
+                os.path.normpath(updated_cons.get_path()),
+                os.path.normpath(to_db_path(hint_sug, base_dir)),
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(hint_sug))
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
+
+    def test_consolidate_media_location_path_selector_widget(self) -> None:
+        """ConsolidateMediaLocationDialog provides a path selector widget that sets database media path."""
+        custom_path = os.path.join(USER_HOME, "SelectorTestMedia")

+    def test_consolidate_media_location_radio_buttons_move_vs_copy(self) -> None:
+        """ConsolidateMediaLocationDialog provides radio buttons for move files vs make a copy."""
+        dlg = ConsolidateMediaLocationDialog(dbstate=self.dbstate)
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(dlg, "radio_move"))
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(dlg, "radio_copy"))

+        self.assertFalse(dlg.radio_copy.get_active())
+
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
+            test_file = os.path.join(temp_dir, "test.jpg")
+            with open(test_file, "w") as f:
+                f.write("content")
+
+            with DbTxn("Create media for move", self.db) as trans:
+                m = Media()

+                    "entry": {
+                        "handle": m_h,
+                        "raw_path": test_file,
+                        "src_full": test_file,
+                        "gramps_id": "O0001",
+                    },
+                    "path_entry": mock_entry,
+                }
+            ]
+
+            with (
+                patch(
+                    "gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.relocate_file",
+                    return_value=(True, ""),

+            ):
+                dlg.cb_apply(MagicMock())

+                self.assertFalse(mock_relocate.call_args[1].get("copy", False))

+                    return_value=(True, ""),
+                ) as mock_relocate,
+                patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.OkDialog"),

+    def test_is_in_default_path(self) -> None:
+        """is_in_default_path detects relative and absolute paths within base_dir."""
+        base = os.path.join(USER_HOME, "MediaBase")
+        self.assertTrue(is_in_default_path("photos/family.jpg", base))
+        self.assertTrue(is_in_default_path("simple.png", base))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            is_in_default_path(os.path.join(base, "photos", "family.jpg"), base)
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(
+            is_in_default_path(os.path.join(USER_HOME, "OtherDir", "pic.jpg"), base)
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(is_in_default_path("", base))
+        self.assertFalse(is_in_default_path("photos/family.jpg", ""))

+            m1 = Media()
+            m1.set_description("Photo 1")
+            m1.set_path("shared/sample.jpg")
+            m1_h = self.db.add_media(m1, trans)
+
+            m2 = Media()
+            m2.set_description("Photo 2")
+            m2.set_path("shared/sample.jpg")
+            m2_h = self.db.add_media(m2, trans)
+
+            # Person links to m1
+            p = Person()
+            mref = MediaRef()
+            mref.set_reference_handle(m1_h)
+            p.add_media_reference(mref)
+            self.db.add_person(p, trans)
+
+        groups = find_duplicate_media_groups(self.db)
+        self.assertEqual(len(groups), 1)
+        g = groups[0]
+        self.assertEqual(len(g["records"]), 2)
+        # Keeper should be m1 because it has a backlink from Person
+        self.assertEqual(g["keeper"]["handle"], m1_h)
+
+    def test_fix_media_references_dialog_merge(self) -> None:
+        """FixMediaReferencesDialog merges duplicate records into keeper."""
+        with DbTxn("Create duplicate media for merge", self.db) as trans:
+            m1 = Media()
+            m1.set_description("Primary Photo")
+            m1.set_path("shared/test.jpg")
+            m1_h = self.db.add_media(m1, trans)
+
+            p1 = Person()
+            mr1 = MediaRef()
+            mr1.set_reference_handle(m1_h)
+            p1.add_media_reference(mr1)
+            self.db.add_person(p1, trans)
+
+            m2 = Media()
+            m2.set_description("Duplicate Photo")
+            m2.set_path("shared/test.jpg")
+            m2_h = self.db.add_media(m2, trans)
+
+            p2 = Person()
+            mref = MediaRef()
+            mref.set_reference_handle(m2_h)
+            p2.add_media_reference(mref)
+            p2_h = self.db.add_person(p2, trans)
+
+        dlg = FixMediaReferencesDialog(dbstate=self.dbstate)
+        self.assertEqual(len(dlg.groups), 1)
+
+        # Select option 0: merge into keeper
+        mock_combo = MagicMock()
+        mock_combo.get_active.return_value = 0
+        dlg.row_targets = [
+            {
+                "group": dlg.groups[0],
+                "action_combo": mock_combo,
+            }
+        ]
+
+        with patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gw_fixmediareferencesdialog.OkDialog"):
+            dlg.cb_apply(MagicMock())
+
+        # m2 should be merged into m1 and removed
+        self.assertIsNotNone(self.db.get_media_from_handle(m1_h))
+        with self.assertRaises(HandleError):
+            self.db.get_media_from_handle(m2_h)
+
+        # Person p2's media reference should now point to m1
+        person = self.db.get_person_from_handle(p2_h)
+        self.assertEqual(person.get_media_list()[0].get_reference_handle(), m1_h)

+    def test_fix_media_references_dialog_copy(self) -> None:
+        """FixMediaReferencesDialog creates separate copies of files for duplicate records."""
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:

+    def test_check_path_permission_ancestors(self) -> None:
+        """check_path_permission identifies the highest-level directory that cannot be read."""
+        temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            restricted_dir = os.path.join(temp_dir, "RestrictedDir")
+            os.makedirs(restricted_dir)
+            test_file = os.path.join(restricted_dir, "nested", "photo.jpg")
+
+            orig_scandir = os.scandir
+
+            def mock_scandir(p: Any) -> Any:
+                if os.path.normcase(str(p)) == os.path.normcase(restricted_dir):
+                    raise PermissionError(13, "Access is denied", restricted_dir)
+                return orig_scandir(p)
+
+            with patch(
+                "gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.os.scandir",
+                side_effect=mock_scandir,
+            ):
+                has_issue, inaccess = check_path_permission(test_file)
+                self.assertTrue(has_issue)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    os.path.normcase(inaccess or ""),
+                    os.path.normcase(restricted_dir),
+                )
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
+

+    def test_consolidate_location_blocked_by_duplicate_references(self) -> None:
+        """Consolidate media location requires resolving duplicate references first."""
+        with DbTxn("Create duplicate media references", self.db) as trans:
+            m1 = Media()
+            m1.set_description("Census 1")
+            m1.set_path(r"C:\photos\shared_census.jpg")

+            m2 = Media()
+            m2.set_description("Census 2")

+            self.db.add_media(m2, trans)
+

+        tool_instance = GWizardMediaFix.__new__(GWizardMediaFix)
+        tool_instance.dbstate = self.dbstate

+
+        with (
+            patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.OkDialog") as mock_dialog,
+            patch(
+                "gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.ConsolidateMediaLocationDialog"

+            mock_dialog.assert_called_once()
+            self.assertIn(
+                "Resolve Duplicate References First",
+                mock_dialog.call_args[0][0],
+            )
+            mock_dlg_class.assert_not_called()
+
+        # 2. ConsolidateMediaLocationDialog disables action buttons when duplicate files exist
+        dlg = ConsolidateMediaLocationDialog(dbstate=self.dbstate)
+        self.assertTrue(len(dlg.dup_files) > 0)
+        self.assertFalse(dlg.apply_button.get_sensitive())
+        self.assertFalse(dlg.accept_button.get_sensitive())
+
+        with patch("gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.OkDialog") as mock_dialog:
+            dlg.cb_apply(MagicMock())
+            mock_dialog.assert_called_once()
+            self.assertIn("Cannot Consolidate Files", mock_dialog.call_args[0][0])
+
+        # 3. Sanity check in cb_apply: duplicate source files in row_targets blocks move
+        dlg.dup_files = []  # Bypass initial check to test batch conflict detection
+        mock_entry1 = MagicMock()
+        mock_entry1.get_text.return_value = "C:/dest/new1.jpg"
+        mock_entry2 = MagicMock()
+        mock_entry2.get_text.return_value = "C:/dest/new2.jpg"
+        dlg.row_targets = [
+            {
+                "entry": {
+                    "handle": "h1",
+                    "raw_path": r"C:\photos\shared_census.jpg",
+                    "gramps_id": "O1",

+            {
+                "entry": {

+                    "gramps_id": "O2",
+                },
+                "path_entry": mock_entry2,
+            },

+        with (

+                "gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.find_duplicate_media_groups",
+                return_value=[],

+            )

+    def test_auto_all_accept_all_hints(self) -> None:
+        """Accept all hints executes automated fixes and reports items requiring human intervention."""
+        temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        try:
+            base_dir = os.path.join(temp_dir, "MediaBase")
+            os.makedirs(base_dir, exist_ok=True)
+            self.db.set_mediapath(base_dir)
+
+            # 1. Missing file that exists in base_dir
+            found_file = os.path.join(base_dir, "found.jpg")
+            with open(found_file, "w") as f:
+                f.write("content")
+
+            # 2. Source file for consolidation on disk
+            consol_src = os.path.join(temp_dir, "scattered.png")
+            with open(consol_src, "w") as f:
+                f.write("content")
+
+            with DbTxn("Create media records for auto_all", self.db) as trans:
+                # Missing media that can be resolved
+                m_found = Media()
+                m_found.set_description("Found Media")
+                m_found.set_path("lost/found.jpg")
+                h_found = self.db.add_media(m_found, trans)
+
+                p_found = Person()
+                mref_f = MediaRef()
+                mref_f.set_reference_handle(h_found)
+                p_found.add_media_reference(mref_f)
+                self.db.add_person(p_found, trans)
+
+                # Trully missing media that requires human intervention
+                m_unresolved = Media()
+                m_unresolved.set_description("Unresolved Media")
+                m_unresolved.set_path("truly/missing_forever.jpg")
+                h_unres = self.db.add_media(m_unresolved, trans)
+
+                p_unres = Person()
+                mref_u = MediaRef()
+                mref_u.set_reference_handle(h_unres)
+                p_unres.add_media_reference(mref_u)
+                self.db.add_person(p_unres, trans)
+
+                # Unreferenced image tag (file exists on disk, but 0 data references)
+                orphan_file = os.path.join(temp_dir, "orphan.jpg")
+                with open(orphan_file, "w") as f:
+                    f.write("content")
+                m_orphan = Media()
+                m_orphan.set_description("Orphan Media")
+                m_orphan.set_path(orphan_file)
+                h_orphan = self.db.add_media(m_orphan, trans)
+
+                # Duplicate references to consol_src
+                m_dup1 = Media()
+                m_dup1.set_description("Shared Photo 1")
+                m_dup1.set_path(consol_src)
+                h_dup1 = self.db.add_media(m_dup1, trans)
+
+                m_dup2 = Media()
+                m_dup2.set_description("Shared Photo 2")
+                m_dup2.set_path(consol_src)
+                h_dup2 = self.db.add_media(m_dup2, trans)
+
+                # Link person to dup1 so dup1 is chosen as keeper
+                p = Person()
+                mref = MediaRef()
+                mref.set_reference_handle(h_dup1)
+                p.add_media_reference(mref)
+                self.db.add_person(p, trans)
+
+            tool_instance = GWizardMediaFix.__new__(GWizardMediaFix)
+            tool_instance.dbstate = self.dbstate
+            tool_instance.window = MagicMock()
+
+            # Test cancellation: confirm_plan returns False
+            with patch(
+                "gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.confirm_plan",
+                return_value=False,
+            ):
+                tool_instance.cb_auto_all()
+                # Should do nothing
+                self.assertIsNotNone(self.db.get_media_from_handle(h_orphan))
+
+            # Test acceptance: confirm_plan returns True
+            with (
+                patch(
+                    "gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.confirm_plan",
+                    return_value=True,
+                ),
+                patch(
+                    "gramps.plugins.tool.gwizardmediafix.AcceptAllHintsReportDialog"
+                ) as mock_report_cls,
+            ):
+                tool_instance.cb_auto_all()
+                mock_report_cls.assert_called_once()
+                kwargs = mock_report_cls.call_args[1]
+                report_title = kwargs.get("title", "")
+                report_body = kwargs.get("report_text", "")
+
+                self.assertIn("Accept All Hints Complete", report_title)
+                self.assertIn("AUTOMATED CHANGES PERFORMED:", report_body)
+                self.assertIn(
+                    "Find missing media: 1 missing path(s) found", report_body
+                )
+                self.assertIn(
+                    "Fix media references: 1 duplicate record(s) merged, 1 unreferenced image tag(s) deleted.",
+                    report_body,
+                )
+                self.assertIn("CHANGES REQUIRING HUMAN INTERVENTION:", report_body)
+                self.assertIn("Missing files on disk (1)", report_body)
+                self.assertIn("missing_forever.jpg", report_body)
+
+                # Orphan was deleted
+                with self.assertRaises(HandleError):
+                    self.db.get_media_from_handle(h_orphan)
+
+                # Duplicate was merged into keeper
+                with self.assertRaises(HandleError):
+                    self.db.get_media_from_handle(h_dup2)
+                self.assertIsNotNone(self.db.get_media_from_handle(h_dup1))
+        finally:
+            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
+
+    def test_accept_all_hints_report_dialog_selectable_label(self) -> None:
+        """AcceptAllHintsReportDialog uses SelectableLabel so text can be highlighted and copied."""
+        from gramps.plugins.tool.gwizard_common import SelectableLabel
+
+        sample_report = (
+            "AUTOMATED CHANGES PERFORMED:\n  • Find missing media: 1 path updated."
+        )
+        dlg = AcceptAllHintsReportDialog(report_text=sample_report)
+        self.assertTrue(hasattr(dlg, "report_label"))
+        self.assertIsInstance(dlg.report_label, SelectableLabel)
+        self.assertTrue(dlg.report_label.selectable)
+        self.assertEqual(dlg.report_label.text, sample_report)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Build the standalone ``MediaFix.zip`` addon package.
+
+This script mirrors ``package_gwizard_filemerge.py`` but bundles the
+media‑fix related tools listed in ``changed_files.txt``.  It collects the
+relevant source modules, rewrites their imports to flat sibling imports, and
+produces a zip file that can be installed as a Gramps addon.
+"""
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Standard Python modules
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+from __future__ import annotations
+import argparse
+import logging
+import re
+import zipfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+PACKAGE = "MediaFix"
+GPR_FILENAME = "MediaFix.gpr.py"
+
+# Minimal registration template – the real plugin registration is already
+# present in ``gramps/plugins/tool/tools.gpr.py``; we embed a tiny stub that
+# points to the main tool module.
+GPR_TEMPLATE = """\
+# Gramps registration file for the MediaFix tool.
+
+from gramps.gen.plug._pluginreg import TOOL, TOOL_DBPROC, TOOL_MODE_GUI, EXPERIMENTAL, EXPERT
+from gramps.gen.const import GRAMPS_LOCALE as glocale
+from gramps.version import major_version, VERSION_TUPLE
+
+_ = glocale.translation.gettext
+
+if (5, 2, 0) <= VERSION_TUPLE <= (6, 2, 0):
+    register(
+        TOOL,
+        id="gwizardmediafix",
+        name=_("Media Fix"),
+        description=_("Fix media references in a Gramps database."),
+        version="__MEDIAFIX_VERSION__",
+        gramps_target_version=major_version,
+        status=EXPERIMENTAL,
+        audience=EXPERT,
+        fname="gwizardmediafix.py",
+        authors=["Kevin White"],
+        authors_email=["gocaveman@gmail.com"],
+        category=TOOL_DBPROC,
+        toolclass="GWizardMediaFixTool",
+        optionclass="GWizardMediaFixOptions",
+        tool_modes=[TOOL_MODE_GUI],
+    )
+"""
+
+# Map of archive member name -> source file relative to the repo root.
+SOURCES: dict[str, str] = {
+    "gwizardmediafix.py": "gramps/plugins/tool/gwizardmediafix.py",
+    "gwizard_common.py": "gramps/plugins/tool/gwizard_common.py",
+    "gw_fixmediareferencesdialog.py": "gramps/plugins/tool/gw_fixmediareferencesdialog.py",
+}
+
+# Simple import rewrite rules – flatten imports from ``gramps.plugins.tool``
+REWRITES: tuple[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str], ...] = (
+    (
+        re.compile(r"from\s+gramps\.plugins\.tool\.gwizardmediafix\s+import\b"),
+        "from gwizardmediafix import",
+    ),
+    (
+        re.compile(r"from\s+gramps\.plugins\.tool\.gwizard_common\s+import\b"),
+        "from gwizard_common import",
+    ),
+    (
+        re.compile(
+            r"from\s+gramps\.plugins\.tool\.gw_fixmediareferencesdialog\s+import\b"
+        ),
+        "from gw_fixmediareferencesdialog import",
+    ),
+    (
+        re.compile(
+            r"from\s+\.+(gwizardmediafix|gwizard_common|gw_fixmediareferencesdialog)\s+import\b"
+        ),
+        r"from \1 import",
+    ),
+)
+
+
+def rewrite_imports(text: str) -> str:
+    """Rewrite plugin imports to flat sibling imports."""
+    for pattern, replacement in REWRITES:
+        text = pattern.sub(replacement, text)
+    return text
+
+
+def rewrite_imports_bytes(data: bytes) -> bytes:
+    lines = data.decode("utf-8").splitlines(keepends=False)
+    rewritten = [rewrite_imports(line) for line in lines]
+    return ("\n".join(rewritten) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def build_gpr(version: str = "0.0.1") -> bytes:
+    return GPR_TEMPLATE.replace("__MEDIAFIX_VERSION__", version).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def build_zip(repo_root: Path, output: Path, version: str = "0.0.1") -> Path:
+    """Create the addon zip file.
+
+    Returns the path to the created zip.  Raises ``FileNotFoundError`` if any
+    source file is missing.
+    """
+    members: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for member, source in SOURCES.items():
+        path = repo_root / source
+        if not path.is_file():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing source file: {path}")
+        members[member] = rewrite_imports_bytes(path.read_bytes())
+        LOG.debug("Added %s (%d bytes)", source, len(members[member]))
+
+    # Ensure a clean slate.
+    output.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+        archive.writestr(PACKAGE + "/", b"")
+        archive.writestr(f"{PACKAGE}/{GPR_FILENAME}", build_gpr(version))
+        for member in sorted(members):
+            archive.writestr(f"{PACKAGE}/{member}", members[member])
+
+    LOG.info("Successfully wrote %s (%d bytes)", output, output.stat().st_size)
+    print(f"✅ Built addon zip: {output} ({output.stat().st_size} bytes)")
+    return output
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build the MediaFix addon zip.")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "-o",
+        "--output",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="Destination zip file (default: MediaFix_v<version>.zip next to script).",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--version",
+        dest="version_opt",
+        default="0.0.1",
+        help="MediaFix plugin version (default: 0.0.1).",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "version_pos",
+        nargs="?",
+        default=None,
+        help="Positional version overrides --version.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "-v",
+        "--verbose",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="Enable verbose output (debug logging).",
+    )
+    return parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = parse_args(argv)
+    # Configure logging based on the verbose flag.
+    log_level = logging.DEBUG if getattr(args, "verbose", False) else logging.INFO
+    logging.basicConfig(level=log_level, format="%(levelname)s: %(message)s")
+    # args already parsed above
+    repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    version = args.version_pos if args.version_pos is not None else args.version_opt
+    output = (
+        repo_root / f"MediaFix_v{version}.zip"
+        if args.output is None
+        else (args.output if args.output.is_absolute() else repo_root / args.output)
+    )
+    try:
+        built = build_zip(repo_root, output, version)
+    except FileNotFoundError as err:
+        LOG.error("Error: %s", err)
+        print(f"❌ Build failed: {err}")
+        return 1
+    # The build_zip function already prints a success line.
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
